entries.title: Armor Synthesis Introduction
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
"Good," Ada says as she types feverishly on her workstation.


"I used the data you streamed from Europa to make some final adjustments to the device.


"The original plans from Clovis are out of reach - whatever he wanted to make from this, it requires theoretical alloys that don't exist. Given what we know about him now, maybe it's best if that vision never comes to fruition…


"In any case, I was able to use some concepts from the original Forge designs to finish the prototype. It's my own design now.


She steps back from the workstation.


"The processing unit is the final piece. You retrieved it, it's only fair that you get to close this out."


Interact with the Loom prototype to connect the processing unit.

entries.title: Armor Synthesis Introduction
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
Ada tells you that the Black Armory Forges have been lost. In their absence, she is working on a new project; some unfinished research she unearthed in the BrayTech archives on Europa.


She says she needs help retrieving the last remaining research data from Europa's surface, as it's not accessible via the network.


Travel to the BrayTech facility on Europa and recover the data.

entries.title: Armor Synthesis Introduction

entries.quote: Ada is awestruck at what she has accomplished with the Loom, and relieved to have a new beginning for the Armory. She thanks you for your help and expresses excitement about the future.

entries.title: Asset Protection
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
Ada-1 is poring over the data collected during your run through the heist simulation. She looks up excitedly.


"Good job, Guardian! This worked even better than expected," she says. "I was able to recreate the weapon perfectly based on your efforts."


She disappears into a back room and returns with a sleek Pulse Rifle. "Just as dangerous as the day it was created," she says as she hands it to you.


"I can give you more build options for it," she continues, "if you meet specific conditions on subsequent runs through the simulation."


"I'll also need some Inert SIVA Clusters," she says. "The clusters themselves aren't dangerous, but I can't say the same for the Fallen holding them."


She admires the weapon in your hands. "It's good to be weapon-smithing again, Guardian."

entries.title: Asset Protection
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
"It's good to see you again, Guardian," Ada-1 greets you. "Recent events have stirred up unpleasant family memories from the Golden Age, and I'm glad to be working with someone I can trust."


"Lord Shaxx and I are determined to get you ready to face the Witness," she continues. "I can recreate a famous, or maybe infamous, weapon from your past. But I'll need your help."


"Several years ago, you foiled a heist in the Old Tower. I've created a simulation of the events using modified Vex tech from the Infinite Forest," she explains.


"I can extrapolate data from your run through the simulation and use it to re-fashion the weapon. Perhaps even improve upon it."


"Anything to save us from another Collapse," she concludes. "I can't lose another family that way."

entries.title: Exotic Archetype Focusing
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
Ada looks up from her work as you approach.


"I've been doing some experiments with the Sieve. Customized reinforcements for our veteran Guardians."


She gestures to some neatly stacked boxes, which light the room with an enticing yellow glow. 


"I discovered a method to reproduce some of our most effective armor. It worked wonderfully but proved too expensive for mass production."


"It would be a waste to let the prototypes go unused, so the Vanguard authorized me to distribute them." She hands you a small pile of requisition orders.


"Just remember-I only have so many to hand out. Once you've made your selections, let me know, and I'll pull them out of storage for you."

entries.title: Outbreak Refined I
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
Ada-1 takes the Inert SIVA Clusters from you and puts them in a large centrifuge. As it spins, she runs a series of elaborate computations based on the data you collected. 


It takes a long moment, but she finally hails you:


"I've done it!" she exclaims. "I didn't want to tell you before, but I wasn't sure this would work. The simulation data is all extrapolation, and I wasn't sure the Inert SIVA would be sufficient…"


"But it worked!" She hands your weapon back. It has the faint metallic odor of ozone. 


"Now you can reshape it with added options," she says with satisfaction. "And don't mind the odor. That should fade."

entries.title: Outbreak Refined I
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
"Normally I wouldn't meddle with a design like Outbreak," Ada says. "But extraordinary times call for extraordinary measures. And a potential second Collapse certainly qualifies."


"It will require some experimentation," she continues, "but if you can get me more detailed data from the heist simulation, as well as some Inert SIVA Clusters, I'm sure I can push this design past its intended threshold."

entries.title: Outbreak Refined II
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
Ada-1's eyes shine with a particular brightness as she takes the SIVA Clusters from you and installs them into her bank of machines.


"Well done. Once you reshape this weapon, you'll find an additional combat option available for use."


She tilts her head slightly. "Let's hope the forces of the Witness find this nanotech as troubling as the City did."

entries.title: Outbreak Refined II
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
"Guardian, I'm excited to see you back!" Ada-1 welcomes you. "After our last experiment, my mind was on fire with the potential for this type of iteration."


"Reproducing Outbreak was relatively simple, but attempting to upgrade it was a shot in the dark," she continues. "But it paid off! I'm sure I could push it even further if you provided more simulation data and Inert SIVA Clusters."


"This is exactly the type of reckless experimentation the foundries usually avoid," she says conspiratorially. "But nothing ventured, nothing gained."

entries.title: Outbreak Refined III
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
Ada-1 opens the security protocols on her datapad and sets them to maximum.


"You're back! That's… exciting," she says nervously. "I'll make more modifications to your weapon, but this will be the final one. The risks are becoming greater with each iteration."


She takes the weapon and the Inert SIVA and disappears into a back room.


She emerges after a moment. Behind her, you see several Redjacks scorching the room with flamethrowers.


"All done!" she exclaims with relief. "You'll have a new option the next time you reshape the weapon."


"Let's hope that's enough for the Witness," she says. "It certainly is for me."

entries.title: Outbreak Refined III
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
Ada-1 looks over both shoulders as you approach.


"Guardian, this experimentation process has been thrilling," she says, "but I'm not sure how much more I can extrapolate from your simulation data."


"Enough for one more upgrade, I think." She looks down at the calculations on her datapad. "But after that, I must move on."


"Working with SIVA, even inert, is dangerous business. But certainly not more dangerous than the Witness."

entries.title: Ploughshares to Swords
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
"Hello, Guardian. I hope the new armaments Shaxx has provided are to your liking." 


For a moment you think that is all Ada-1 will say about the matter, but then she turns to face you.


"It was… pleasant to turn my mind to weapon crafting again," she admits. "The Black Armory Forges may be lost to me, but that doesn't mean I must shed all of my research." 


"There is satisfaction in defending our people against a hostile universe… even if that means reconciling with necessary dangers. But peace must be our foremost aim. If we can't even imagine it, what hope is there of achieving it?"


This, you gather, is something she has been asking herself for some time. Ada-1 searches your expression before continuing. 


"There wasn't much hope left to us during the Dark Age. Nobody expected humanity to claw our way out of the rubble. To fight for a second chance." 


"Now I pin my hopes on you, Guardian. Bring us justice."

Ada folds her arms behind her back. "This Festival of yours is new to me," she says. "But the Black Armory has always been a celebration of history, of tradition, of memory. This seems much the same."


She nods. "Thank you for welcoming me into your City's festivities, Guardian."

entries.title: The Black Armory
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
Due to the Red War, the Black Armory lost access to its forge in the EDZ. Since then, Ada-1 has been unable to locate it herself. Though she maintains a distrust for Guardians, Ada-1 hands you a weapon frame in case you are able to locate the forge. With this frame, you will be able to craft a black armory weapon, but not before calibrating it and bringing it back to Ada-1.


Follow the steps to calibrate the weapon frame.

entries.quote:
Ada-1 is inspired... by a Guardian, by you. The Black Armory can begin to stand on its own feet once again, and it's all thanks to your efforts. Ada-1's gain is also your own, as there are many more black armory weapons to craft and wield.

Unfortunately, Siviks got to them first and tore out many of the pages. Ada-1 insists that you find them all and return them to her, so that the journals may be whole once again.

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
"I saw that Eva Levante has set up her stall," Ada says. "For some event called the 'Guardian Games.' It's hard to believe that Guardians have time for games."


Her voice softens a bit. "But Eva is a kind woman. If she endorses this holiday, then I believe it must bring some good to the City." She eyes you. "Good luck with your Games, Guardian."

Ada-1 is very pleased. Your burgeoning relationship with the Black Armory is beginning to bear fruit.


Come back to Ada-1 to get new weapon frames for the recently discovered Gofannon Forge and craft more Black Armory weapons.

entries.title: Tying It All Together
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
Ada admires your newly minted Synthweave as you approach.


"I must admit, it was a little unnerving to watch someone else operate the Loom. I've put quite a lot of effort into creating this and… I'm feeling a bit protective."


She clears her throat and fixes her posture.


"That being said, it clearly worked as intended. I've gathered data from your production job-with enough information, I may be able to amend this technology toward some other purpose in the future."


"To that end, let's start gathering more Synthstrand for another run."


Gather enough Synthstrand to purchase another Threader bounty. Synthstrand drops from defeating opponents anywhere in the system.

entries.title: Tying It All Together
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
"That Synthstrand looks high quality. You've done well," Ada says.


"I don't think there's much else for me to review with you. Please keep utilizing the Loom so I can compile more data-who knows where it will lead. And thank you again, Guardian."


She turns back to her workstation but stops abruptly, turning her attention back to you.


"What is it that old saying? The ball is in your court now?"


She tilts her head.


"I'm not really sure what that means-but good luck, friend."

entries.title: Tying It All Together
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
Ada's mechanical fingers clack away at a glass touchscreen. "Initial readouts look promising-power levels are stable and the operating system hasn't hit any assertions."


She says the words carefully and meticulously, like they don't fit well around her voice yet.


"As far as I can tell, the Loom is ready for production. Let me give it a test run and see what we get, and if it passes quality checks, I'll explain the process."

entries.title: Tying It All Together
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
"Here it is-the first printing," Ada says tenuously.


"This is Synthweave, a programmable matter more sophisticated than I've ever seen, significantly more advanced than Glimmer."


She hands you a sample of the Loom's output.


"Do the honors of trying it out. It should be able to replicate the physical appearance of some of your armor, though not the material or energy properties."


Use Synthweave to create an ornament from your collection of Legendary armor.

entries.title: Tying It All Together
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
"The Loom requires material input to function; strands of basic matter that can be repurposed as needed," Ada explains.


"I've used the BrayTech schematics to create smaller devices called Threaders-with these, you can convert the strands into the Synthcord that the Loom needs. We should verify the Threaders are functioning as well…"


She hands you a spool of Synthstrand.


"Take these strands, and let's put them through the whole pipeline."


Use Synthstrand to purchase an Armor Synthesis bounty from Ada.

entries.title: Where on the Moon Is Archie?
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote: "Such a bleak place, the Moon. So… haunted. At any rate, Archie brought something back for you. Archie seems really excited about it."

entries.title: Where on the Moon Is Archie?
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote: "I promised Ana I'd keep an eye on Archie, but that dog ran past here with three green eyes on his display. Could you check in on Eris on the Moon for me?"

entries.title: Your Reputation Grows
entries.speaker: Ada-1
entries.quote:
Your thoroughness in assisting the Black Armory has borne fruit. You have helped Ada-1 unlock secrets hidden away in her subconscious mind.


Great Job!

entries.title: Exotic Obtained
entries.speaker: Altar of Relativity
entries.quote:
The Altar of Relativity hums as you approach, and an armament for the Weapon materializes.


Collect your reward for completing all missions on Legendary difficulty.

entries.title: Explore Kepler: Fabled
entries.speaker: Altar of Relativity
entries.quote: Track your Fabled exploration progress and strangelet capsule collection.

entries.title: Explore Kepler: Mythic
entries.speaker: Altar of Relativity
entries.quote: Collect strangelet capsules in World Tier: Mythic and integrate them at the Altar of Relativity.

entries.title: The Edge of Fate
entries.speaker: Altar of Relativity
entries.quote:
As you access the interface, it melds with Rosetta, Rojin's words form in your mind. 


"This is all that is needed to align with the final strangelet."


There is a brief pause as calculations are run and ciphers are drafted. The Altar hums along.


"The Gorge can be accessed. Be wary, Anomaly-Blessed. The automatons that attacked Kepler have made the Gorge their home. Orin, saint of the Anomaly, has already departed to face them. Together, you will prevail."

entries.title: The Edge of Fate
entries.speaker: Altar of Relativity
entries.quote:
The Altar of Relativity appears to be a relic of a bygone era-a jump drive converted from pre-Golden Age technology. It's been damaged and repaired with components that are obviously straining to contain the forces surging inside. Ghost remarks, "Singularity stabilizers likely aren't an off-the-shelf item."


The Aionians have been extremely clever and resourceful in assembling this complex device, despite their relative lack of resources. Still, the altar is definitely unstable. Strangelet capsules appear to be the only method of effectively stabilizing the altar, and by extension, the singularity.

entries.title: The Edge of Fate
entries.speaker: Altar of Relativity
entries.quote:
As you access the interface, it melds with Rosetta, Rojin's words form in your mind. 


"Anomaly-Blessed, your field work is efficient and thorough. We are fortunate to have found favor with you. With the return of another strangelet, we are able to cull bad data from our hypotheses. We've narrowed your next destination to the Outer Steppes. We are locking the Altar to that strangelet capsule now." 


"Go in certainty."

entries.title: The Edge of Fate
entries.speaker: Altar of Relativity
entries.quote:
As you approach the Altar you feel a strange kind of hum. It is not audible, but you can feel it both physically and paracausually within you.
There is also something else there, a new…feeling? It's not anything you've experienced before. It's some kind of resonance beyond the physical and paracausal.
You feel satiated, and yet there is a sense that there is much more to whet your appetite on this planetoid… and elsewhere.
It seems that you've taken your first step into a larger, stranger world.

entries.title: The Edge of Fate
entries.speaker: Altar of Relativity
entries.quote:
The language of the interface is indecipherable, but the altar appears to be unpowered. It cannot process a strangelet capsule integration.


Ghost is tracing power transfers around the altar site. The source appears to be dark matter conduits, most likely kept away from the Aionian security zone for safety.


Ghost believes it's possible to restore power.

entries.title: The Edge of Fate
entries.speaker: Altar of Relativity
entries.quote:
As you access the interface, it melds with Rosetta, speaking words from an Aionian into your inner voice. 


"Anomaly-Blessed. I am Rojin, the Altar's technician, and the one honored to deliver what help we can. We offer, in awe, our findings to aid you. Should you see fit, your impressive drone will receive actionable data to locate strangelet capsules, and use the Altar's relativistic connection with them as a cipher to pass into the cordoned regions of Kepler. With our current integrations and research, you will gain access to the Central Academy and the Exile's Accord."


There is a brief pause as Ghost accepts the data transmission.


"Most gracious, Anomaly-blessed. Transfer commencing."


"We shall continue our research into the other stolen strangelets. With further integrations, the remaining capsules will increase synchronicity with the Altar and allow us to impose a shifted perspective that ignores the cordons by our observation of the strangelet beyond them. It is a delicate alignment, but our efforts can only improve through iteration."

entries.title: A Guardian Rises
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
"Hey there," Amanda says as she stands up from a disassembled Sparrow engine. She wipes grease off her hands with a dirty towel.


"You must be Shaw's pal. He told me you were coming; said to take it easy on you." She offers a casual smile.


"Name's Holliday; I run the Hangar here in the Tower. You need anything relatin' to ships, Sparrows, or any other kind of engine, you come to me."


"I'll take care of your bird here while you get the lay of the land. I think Zavala was expecting you up in the Courtyard."


"You take care now," she says with a wave as she grabs a wrench and dives back into her work.

entries.title: Amanda Holliday
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
Amanda will be glad to get closure and to see you safe. Go talk to her in the Tower Hangar.



        Forward momentum, Guardian. Forward momentum.

entries.title: Amanda Holliday
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
Cayde-6 and Amanda Holliday were close. Go check on her to see how she's processing Cayde's death.



        Amanda is resilient. If she weren't, she would never have made it to the Last City. But losing your family never gets easier.

entries.title: Amanda Holliday
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
Amanda Holliday is back in the Hangar and doing what she loves most-tinkering with and rebuilding ships and Sparrows. She might not be a Guardian, but she certainly left her mark on the Red War. Now, she has a present for you. 


Visit Amanda for all your ships and Sparrow needs.

entries.title: Amanda Holliday
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
Amanda Holliday is back in the Hangar and doing what she loves most-tinkering with and rebuilding ships and Sparrows. She might not be a Guardian, but she certainly left her mark on the Red War.


Visit Amanda for all your ship and Sparrow needs.

entries.title: Amanda Howl-iday
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote: "It's been a long year," Amanda says with a weary smile. "And we've lost a lot." She claps a hand on your shoulder. "Let's celebrate what we still have, right?"

entries.title: And to All a Good Flight
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
"Happy Dawning!" Amanda shouts while she dramatically pulls a tarp off a large crate. "It's the last upgrade that festive ship of yours will ever need!"


She stands proudly for a moment, then snaps her fingers. "Shoot," she says, "I shoulda let you open it. Kinda ruined the surprise there. I couldn't help myself!"


"Anyway, I know you been flyin' around, bringin' treats to folk out in the deep black. Wanted you to know we all appreciate it, and I figured you wouldn't mind a little flash on your ride!"

entries.title: And to All a Good Flight
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
"Hot damn!" Amanda exclaims. "I was hopin' you'd bring me some cookies!"


Amanda grins and steps to the side. Behind her idles a gorgeous new ship. "I know it's early, but I thought you could do to drive somethin' a mite more festive." 


"Ain't she a beaut? All yours, in exchange for givin' Eva a hand with somethin'."


"The ol' gal told me she feels some of the Dawning spirit has left the Tower… no surprise after the year we've had, right? You help her lift folks' spirits while I work on a few upgrades for that beautiful ship you've got there, and together we'll have the best damned Dawning this place has ever seen!"

entries.title: Blast from the Past
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
"Good timing! Ran into a snag. I need more info on performance in extreme temperatures to get the metal tempering right."


She flicks the wrench into the air, catches it as it whirls back down, and slides it into a belt loop.


"I hear Guardians are heading out to Europa right now; might be a good spot to generate some data below freezing points. How about it, you gonna help me see this through?"

entries.title: Blast from the Past
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
"Shaw had you running his errands, did he? He's good people, but a bit of nut when it comes to efficient process; 'delegate' might be one of his favorite words."


"Anywho, this data is great! I've been trying to fix up an old family heirloom for a while now, and this'll help me calibrate the tooling. Only…"


She frowns at the monitor to her side, idly tossing a wrench in one hand.


"I'm going to need some time to crunch these numbers. Come back around in a bit, and I'll have something ready for ya."

entries.title: Blast from the Past
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
"Well, I'll be. That just about did the trick!"


Amanda holds a Slug Shotgun in her hand, intricately ornamented and gleaming with polished metal. She rotates it, testing the weight distribution, then quickly spins it by the lever. A shell ejects as it lands back in her hands, pointed at you.


"Don't be scared now, just givin' it a whirl."


She lowers the barrel and inspects the weapon.


"This lady's been with me a long time. Helped me and ma walk some dangerous roads. Dark times back then…"


She pauses for a moment, watching a damaged Guardian ship limp into the Hangar.


"Darker now. Might be time someone else had the pleasure of her company. Why don't you take her; a thank you for helping out."


"Storm clouds gatherin' out there, Guardian. Keep her safe, and she'll do the same for you."

entries.title: Cheer Up?
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote: Amanda is surprised to see the completed blueprint but doesn't ask questions.

entries.title: Dawning Delivery
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote: Amanda forgets to wipe the grease off her hands before she accepts the cookies. Oh well.

entries.title: Dawning's Gift: Amanda
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote: You blink and Amanda has already swapped her old bandana for one of the new ones… you think.

entries.title: Festival of the Lost
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote: Amanda reflects on how the Festival of the Lost feels this year, and she gives you a gift to celebrate.

entries.title: Festival of the Lost

entries.quote: Amanda congratulates you on defeating the Nightmare in the Haunted Forest and encourages you to return for more holiday cheer.

entries.title: Festival of the Lost

entries.quote: With help from an old friend, Amanda has figured out the cause of the weirdness on Io.

entries.title: Queen of Hearts

entries.quote: Amanda Holliday was able to recover and repair Cayde's personal jumpship after he fell. She feels that he would have wanted you to have it now.

entries.title: Speak to Amanda Holliday
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
"If you wanna know how some of the greatest battles in Guardian history were fought, I've lived through some of the recent ones. Now listen close…"


You can replay classic campaigns by acquiring the quests here. You can play each campaign only once per character.


After acquiring the quest, track it to see where to go to play the next mission.

entries.title: Tex Mechanica Tournament
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote: Amanda congratulates you on your victory! She hopes that when you wield the Chaperone, you remember the humans who made the dangerous journey to the Last Safe City.

entries.title: Tex Mechanica Tournament
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote: The Tex Mechanica weapons foundry has declared a Crucible contest. The prize is a weapon based on the Chaperone, a shotgun Nora Holliday used to protect her family on the refugee roads to the City.

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
Amanda brushes her hands off on her pants as she turns to greet you. "The Tower looks pretty neat, huh?" she asks. "I helped with some of the set-up. Zavala came around asking for help, and I was happy to oblige.


"I can't wait to see who wins." She puts her hands on her hips. "Sometimes Shaxx lets me hang around and watch Crucible matches. You seem like one to watch out for. Good luck."

entries.title: The Lost Cryptarch
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote: Amanda has a tale to tell: one of a death gone unnoticed and a wrong to be righted.

entries.title: The Lost Cryptarch
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote: Amanda is not convinced that this story is over, but she wishes to thank you all the same.

entries.title: The Lost Cryptarch
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote: Amanda has caught a break in the hunt for clues about Master Ives.

entries.title: The Lost Cryptarch
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote: Amanda Holliday gave you the journal of Master Ives, but it's empty. The lost pages are found scattered across the decryption algorithms of Legendary and Exotic engrams, and in the possession of challenging Fallen enemies in the EDZ.

entries.title: The Queen Beckons
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
Amanda grins as she sees you approach with the schematic.


"Now that's what I'm talking about! All that messing around in the Throne World is gonna be worth it, Guardian. Now let's see here…"


Amanda tinkers at the workbench behind her.


"Woo! Wouldn't want to be on the business end of that! Pretty sweet, if I do say so myself."

entries.title: The Queen Beckons
entries.speaker: Amanda Holliday
entries.quote:
Amanda looks up from her work, a flash of curiosity in her eyes.


"You got something for me, Guardian?" she asks, scanning the schematic. "Oh, ho! This thing is a doozy! Or it will be, but it ain't quite done cooking yet."


"You know what might finish it off right…" She stops herself, unsure. "That Witch Queen's throne world-could get some real good data there. As long as you don't die from the creeps!"

entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
"Oh, I love these," Ana says, popping the candy in her mouth. "You got it from the Spider? Weird. Didn't think the Fallen really liked candy."


She crosses her arms. "Did you know that, in the Golden Age, 876 new types of candy were invented? That we know of." She shakes her head. "What a time to be alive."

entries.title: Armed to the Teeth
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
"This time of year is strange for me," Ana says, handing you a chocolate bar without explanation. "I was away from the Last City for so long that I feel… disconnected from those traditions."


She smiles; shrugs. "But I have a lot of respect for all the people who came before us. And I try to honor them, in my own way."

entries.title: Data Recovery
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote: Using a blank spot in his system memory as a clue, Rasputin has helped you and Ana recover designs from Ana's past. Along with forging a new weapon, Rasputin has helped you recover an old blueprint designed by Ana and her sister, Elsie Bray.

entries.quote:
Investigate the blank spot in Rasputin's memory.



        Ana has discovered a blank spot in Rasputin's artificial cortex. She suspects it could be a digitally suppressed memory and could contain valuable information.

entries.title: Escalation Protocol
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
"The Hive are a constant threat to Mars and to humanity, and Rasputin wants to do his part. Bring the Hive to him, and he'll gather all the information he needs to help us keep the planet safe.


To that end… Would you care to pick a fight?"


Successfully complete the final wave of Escalation Protocol and open the final chest using a fully charged Encrypted Cache Key.


Rasputin Key Fragments drop occasionally during Nightfall strikes. Collect 7 Key Fragments and trade them to Ana Bray for an Encrypted Cache Key. Charge your Cache Key by completing rounds of Escalation Protocol.

entries.title: Evacuation: Mars
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
"I'm glad Zavala sent you back down," Ana says and smiles. "He's been asking after Red. It's sweet."


"Here's what I've learned. When he was attacked, Rasputin pushed some of his signal back along the comms relay. He'd be disguised as something benign. We need to find it."


"We can also help the Vanguard. Mars Hive are using a ritual to strengthen Savathûn. Disrupt it. And while you have your weapon drawn…"


She gestures out the window, where towers jut from crimson dunes. "Enact Escalation Protocol. Attract Hive-all the Hive you can-and do what you do."


She takes a breath. "He's still out there," she says. "We're both counting on you."

Have some special loot.

Mars is safer for your efforts.

entries.title: Force Reboot
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
Ana asks you to wait. "I have to do some brain surgery with a soldering iron," she says.


Soon, she pushes back from her desk. Blocky, black chunks of metal and exposed wiring wreath a small cracked viewscreen.


Her voice is hushed, as if a child were sleeping. "There wasn't as much left as I had hoped-a fraction of a percent-but it's him."


She carefully lifts the frame. "He's light," she says in surprise. Then, louder: "You in there, Red?"


The screen flickers soft orange. Ana beams as she turns to you.


"Let Zavala know I'll bring Rasputin to the Tower. Whatever happens next, we'll face it together."


Rasputin's screen pulses weakly with blue tones, then holds strong: a rich, vibrant purple.

entries.title: Fresh Lead
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
"Hmmm. That vault was designed to be impenetrable and someone breaking through Tower security to steal it is equally troubling. If it's the weapon I'm thinking of, I can take one guess who's responsible."


Ana gives you a knowing look.

entries.title: Memories of Helsom
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
"I can't believe you found this," Ana says. "It's Helsom's journal."


"Helsom was a xenoarchaeologist during the Golden Age. He believed there were instances of contact between extrasolar species and humanity, long before the Traveler."


"By all accounts, Helsom was a cigar smoking, whiskey-drinking explorer who hated flying. He'd refused to use jumpships for planetary exploration. Would just hop in a rover and drive halfway across Mars to do his research."


"In spite of all that, every log entry I've ever heard made it sound like he was the happiest guy in the room. His laugh was just…"


Ana seems lost for a moment. "I don't know if Helsom ever found what he was looking for. According to this, he stayed here through the Collapse, because he believed in something."


"I guess I'll have to make that choice, too."

entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
Nascent Dawn



        Ana has fabricated a communications module from the network. It will need to be decrypted before it can function, which may be a complicated process.

Access them once you've obtained enough Resonate Stems from Vanguard patrols, Lost Sectors, high-value targets, public events, and completed challenges. Ana greatly values the data recovered from these nodes. You can socket electronic diaries into Ana's personal server, near the reception area.

entries.quote: Ana has been scouring the Neural Net and found the blueprints to an odd communications module, dating roughly from the end of the Golden Age. Take her replica and see if you can do something with it on your travels.

entries.title: One of Many
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
Ana nods as you approach.


"You weren't the only one Big Red was watching. He got a whole bunch of Guardians to participate. And you stood out. Not sure why."


She frowns. "Your numbers were good, don't get me wrong. But there were a lot of Guardians on this list."


Ana shrugs. "He's sent me a set of strange energy signatures he wants me to share. Looks like he'd like to show you something."

entries.title: Preparation: Mars
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
Ana Bray is studying her monitors in the Clovis Bray facility when you bring her Zavala's message.


"Look at this," she says, indicating a jumble of sine waves in front of her. "Harmonic oscillations. What if, before the Darkness did… whatever it did to him, Rasputin initiated an emergency upload and-"


There's a screeching burst of Hive interference. Her screens flicker as her console reboots.


For a moment, Ana flares with furious Light that scorches her keypad. Then she turns to you, dead calm.


"I could use some support, Guardian."


You draw your weapon. She smiles.

entries.title: Rasputin: Full Power!
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
"Big Red is locked and loaded." Ana beams at Rasputin's hologram, rattling off statistics and terminology. Ghost bobs along in the know.


"This would have been impossible without Zavala acting as a firebrand." She turns introspective for a moment. "It's easy to find reasons to stay away when you're isolated. Easy to forget what kept us close. Coming together won the Gap, and it's going to knock the Almighty out of the sky. It'll be how we meet the future.


Ana's stature rises, proud and decisive.


"When this is over Sol will be so much more open to us. Red's new defense matrix is a scaffold. We could even plop a nice colony down in his shadow on Mars. Just talking about new settlements gives me goose pimples!"


She feigns a shiver and cracks a wide smile at you. "Goodbye war with the Cabal. Hello second Golden Age. The future is bright, Guardian. Shine on."

entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
Ana nods in recognition of successful integrations into Raputin's system. She turns to acknowledge you.


"This is incredible. We had expected a few hiccups if I'm honest." Ana gives a slightly uneasy chuckle.


"Integrating so many systems at once leaves potential for fragmentation. But each bunker connection reads like we're rebuilding old neurons scrubbed from his brain. Like he's remembering." She pauses for a moment in consideration.


"You know, before Zavala came to us about the Almighty we were skipping around the system…" She gives you a quick wary look before continuing. "…chasing leads. Ran into a lot of locked doors. These connections are going to change all that. I've made my travel records available to the Vanguard. Most of them."


Ana notices you about to speak and gives a knowing look. "Big Red and I found something we might need your help with, but now's not the time. Giant kamikaze spaceship first, Ana's baggage later. Yeah?"

entries.title: Return to Ana
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
"Well, this is a bit worse than I hoped."


Ana pores over the intel you've collected.


"Seems Calus's network of assassins-you know, his "Shadows"-are involved. Not sure which one swiped the weapon. You'll have to do some digging, but I'm confident we can collect enough data to point us to where they have the weapon stored. I've heard rumblings of Psions working as double agents within the Red Legion. That's a good place to start."

entries.title: Shades of Red
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
Ana is working desperately at her console. On the screen, a single orange line glows weakly.


"Big Red was too clever for it," she says. "I've detected a part of his signal cycling through the buffer. Problem is, I don't know how to get it out. Not much can safely hold a Warmind."


She picks up a fragment of Rasputin's shattered shell from her desk and rubs her thumb over its silver traces.


You hear the muted thud of Cabal drop pods outside. Ana looks toward the sound wearily.


"I need to figure this out. In the meantime, could you ask the neighbors to keep it down?"


She gives you a grateful nod and turns back to her console.

entries.title: Speak with Ana
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote: "I can't promise we'll get outta this without a few scrapes," Ana tells you as you approach. "But Rasputin can help. Right now, he needs our help, too. He's hoping you can pay him a visit."

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
"Zavala's really been talking up the Guardian Games," Ana says. "He seems pretty excited."


She smiles. "If I wasn't so busy keeping up with Rasputin, I'd join in. But I know you'll win a couple games in my memory." She leans closer. "Don't let the Warlocks or Titans take this one just because they've got Ikora and Zavala behind them. Show them what Hunters can do."

entries.title: The Lie
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
As you approach, Ana frowns in slight confusion as she listens to a few lines of Warmind code echoing from a nearby console.


"Rasputin's asking you for a favor," she translates. "It's a little strange. Are you feeling up for some field duty? He says he wants to … get to know you better."

entries.title: The Lie
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote: Ana needs your help. Band together with fellow Guardians to complete Seraph Tower events across the EDZ, on Io, and on the Moon.

entries.title: The Machine's Gun
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote: Rasputin has finished his calculations and made the necessary modifications to the IKELOS protocol. The sleeper has returned.

entries.title: The Next Chapter
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote: Ana Bray has spent decades searching, but now all her answers are within reach. You have earned her trust and appreciation. With Xol defeated, she wants you to help her dig into Bray's secrets and uncover more of her family's past. Together.

entries.title: United in Victory
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
"We did it. WE actually DID IT!" Ana's face is wracked with a mixture of utter disbelief and joy. "Not just you or me. Not even Rasputin. This was all of us and it couldn't have been any other way."


Her face turns soft for an instant. Ana looks you in the eyes and offers a genuine, "Thank you."


"The Vanguard have their limits. As the City's reach widens, we'll need to consider unlikely allies. It wasn't long ago that most Guardians couldn't imagine standing side by side with a Warmind." Ana allows herself a sly smile and slight head shake.


"Don't worry. We're not interested in being fair-weather friends. Long haul or not at all." She gives you a cheerful nod. "Don't be a stranger. I won't be."

entries.title: Visit Ana Bray
entries.speaker: Ana Bray
entries.quote:
"There's my new favorite Guardian.


"I know it hasn't been easy out here, but there is much more to learn about Rasputin and Clovis Bray on this cold, dead rock. Stay for a while, make a difference."


Continue exploring Mars, and earn XP and new rewards from Ana for completing activities.

entries.title: Visit Ana Bray

entries.quote:
"Nice work pushing back those Hive. They're relentless and vile, but they're no match for you. As thanks, I have a stash of supplies for you that may come in handy."


Continue exploring Mars and aiding Ana Bray to gain XP and new rewards.

entries.title: Act II - Grave Robber
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
Eido squints happily as she accepts the salvage you pilfered from the Tomb of Elders.


"Along with the new reagents you've picked up from that awful place, we might be able to develop new tonics to test on the battlefield."


"I keep asking Crow to let Eramis help us, but he's as immovable as a Walker inside a web grenade discharge. I've been running tonic theory by her anyway, and I think we should see some new results. Soon, I hope, for my father's sake."

entries.title: Act II - Grave Robber
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
Eido's forehead crinkles with worry. "Thank you for patrolling the Prison once again, but I wish you had encountered Fikrul down there, if only to confirm his whereabouts. The combined efforts of House Light and Vanguard scouts haven't been able to find Fikrul, either."


"Eliksni enclaves across the system continue to burn. My father is running out of time. We all are."

entries.title: Act II - Grave Robber
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
"I'm so glad you didn't get thrown in jail too!" Eido gives you a quick hug as you approach.


"I heard everything from Eramis. I'll help get her somewhere safe and hidden within the City."


She looks down at her hands for a moment. "I think I've been too hard on Crow."


"We need you back in the field, but you've taken a burden off my mind. Thank you for your help!" She squints happily.

entries.title: Act III: Kell of Kells
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
Eido shakes her head. "My father is sedated, but he'll soon return as his compromised self. He's been speaking with that other voice more often than his own."


"Now that you've helped me establish direct contact with Ixis, I've had unfettered access to her tonic experience. And I think we've made a breakthrough. I've left you something at the holoprojector, along with instructions for its use."

entries.title: Act III: Kell of Kells
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
Eido acknowledges you as you approach.


"According to Eramis, one of her people, an apothecary named Ixis, has been captured by Fikrul. Ixis has found a way to send messages on public frequencies from somewhere inside the Revenant Fortress. Fikrul either can't intercept her messages or doesn't care she's transmitting. I've studied notes from her that Eramis has passed on, but nothing beats firsthand experience."


"Fikrul remains immortal, but if you can find Ixis in his fortress, she may be able to help us concoct a tonic to defeat him. Or help my father."


She looks at her hands. "If not…  it'd still be nice if you could save the life of someone who's breathed Ether on the Riis of old."

entries.title: Act III: Kell of Kells
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
"I'm the Scribe of our House. Even so, I don't know if I can find the right words to thank you for everything you've done."


"My father's soul is intact. The Houses of Light and Salvation are safe. You made all this possible. I really should thank you formally, as a Slayer Baron of our House. But I hope you know that I consider you a true friend."


"I don't know if we can call Eramis a friend, but… I owe her much. She could have taken the Echo and abandoned us, but she chose to help. Do you think our talks over the past few weeks got through to her? I'd like to think so."


"Maybe Variks really will rebuild the House of Judgment. Maybe we'll divide into many Houses once again. Maybe the Eliksni will drift away from Sol and find new worlds. For now… my people have a new Kell to unite them. To lead them along a path very different from the one that the Kells of old envisioned for us."


"You'll always have a place in that future, Guardian. And a place in the House of Light."

entries.title: Act III: Kell of Kells
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
Eido hefts the Flail that you captured in all four of her hands. "This weapon is loaded with heatsinks! Perfect for kitbashing our brewing machine! We can use it to introduce Solar emissions to our tonics."


She turns the Flail over in her hands. "We've come a long way. We should be able to access new tonics with this. I hope, in the end, it'll be enough to stop Fikrul and help my father…"

entries.title: Act III Key Fieldwork
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote: Eido squints happily at you and nods as you approach. "Thank you for your support as always, Slayer Baron. This is invaluable to my tonic research. I've left you something for your trouble."

entries.title: Act I Key Fieldwork
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote: Eido taps the fingers on her free hands together excitedly as she hands you your reward. "Your support in this fieldwork is invaluable, Slayer Baron. Your contributions will allow me to discover new recipes."

entries.title: Act I - Prologue
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
Eido squints happily at you as you approach, hands clasped in excitement:


"Your support is many-armed, as always, Guardian! Thank you for representing my father as his Slayer Baron. I've left you something for your trouble."

entries.title: Act I - Prologue
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
"So much has happened… I can't believe the H.E.L.M. is gone. We must operate out of the Last City for now." 


Eido welcomes you to her tonic workshop, and explains that, with her help of contacts like Petra, she has been researching ancient Eliksni recipes and concoctions: "Elixirs my forebears used to treat sickness or grant strength." 


"Old Riis was suffused with the Light of the Great Machine. Some of these ingredients must have been too." 


Growing solemn, Eido also admits that Mithrax is unwell. "Nezarec's curse works upon him day by day." 


"But I know there's a solution here somewhere. I won't give up until I find it." 


For now, she suggests you study the Revenants under Fikrul's command. Unsavory as it is, they may provide answers as to his new power. 


But first, she says, "I believe my father wants to speak with you. Please… don't let him know that I'm worried for him."

entries.title: Act II Key Fieldwork
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
Eido nods at you, energized. "Thank you for your help with that fieldwork, Slayer Baron! The lab's like new! I've left you something for your trouble."


She squints in satisfaction at what the two of you have built together. "I hope it's enough to help our people."

entries.title: Episode: Revenant Act I: Eliksni Rescue
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
Eido's many eyes shine with excitement when you return with your first tonic. "Great work! Now that you're familiar with tonics, let's try something more complicated: batch brewing!"


She digs around in some satchels on her belt and withdraws a small drawstring bag. "This should be enough to brew a few more. Our repurposed Walker should be able to process everything in that bag all at once."


She pauses for a moment. "Once you're finished here, you may want to stop by the holoprojector. Variks mentioned he'd reach out soon. I hope it's good news."

entries.title: Episode: Revenant Act I: Eliksni Rescue
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
Eido clasps two of her hands together, glad to see you, as you approach. "Your progress with tonics has been astounding, Slayer Baron." She hunches slightly.


"But Fikrul is still at large, and a shadow continues to loom over my father."


"Crow remains adamant about keeping Eramis confined. I'm worried he's hindering a key source of help for us… At least we have you on the field helping my people. You always manage to find a way out of the dark. House Light and Vanguard scouts are on Fikrul's trail. I'll let you know when we've found something."


"Thank you for everything you've taken on for us, Guardian. I have more to ask. We can bolster my tonic research to create more potent mixtures to aid you if you'll help me with the fieldwork to gather resources and lab equipment I'll need. "


"Eramis has also informed me that House Salvation is missing an Apothecary named Ixis in the wake of Fikrul's attacks. If you'll do me the favor of helping to search for her while you're out in the field, I'm sure she could expedite my research. It'll benefit you in this struggle against Fikrul and it may even help my father and his condition."

entries.title: Episode: Revenant Act I: Eliksni Rescue
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
Eido squints happily at you. "Your support is many-armed as always, Guardian! Every success out in the field opens up opportunities to create more tonics or find new lab equipment."


"House Light and Hunter Vanguard scouts are tracking Fikrul across the Sol System."


She looks at her feet.


"We've been searching the region in every Eliksni enclave he attacks. I'll let you know when we find something. In the meantime, my people need you on the frontline against the Revenants."

entries.title: Episode: Revenant Act I: Eliksni Rescue
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
"Thank you for following up on Eramis's intel," Eido intones as you enter her lab. "And thank you for saving as many Eliksni as you did, with Fikrul getting to that enclave first. A Salvation cell had been holed up there, hoping Fikrul would pass them by." She sighs.


"I know you and Crow did your best-I just wish peace had been a possibility. All the more reason to leverage Eramis's help for the good of those still living."


She pulls several finished tonics from the open mouth of the repurposed Walker. "I'll coordinate with Crow to have scout groups searching for Fikrul's base of operations. He must be gathering Revenants somewhere. We'll be in touch."

entries.title: Revenant Slayer I
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
"I can feel the Revenant energy resonating inside your weapon," Eido notices as you brandish your new Shotgun.


"With some minor adjustments to the frame, I'm sure I can expand its capabilities. Let me take a look!"

entries.title: Revenant Slayer I
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
Eido claps gleefully with her lower arms as you walk in. 


"I'm so happy my frame was useful! It looks much more ferocious now. Luckily, I think it still has plenty of room to grow."


"Because your Shotgun is powered in part by the unique energies of the Revenant Plane," she continues, "it may grant additional abilities within Fikrul's stronghold."


"It might even grant the power to see and interact with the environment in unforeseen ways," she muses. "The secrets you uncover could enable more of its latent power!"

entries.title: Revenant Slayer II
entries.speaker: Apothecary Eido
entries.quote:
"Oh my," Eido exclaims nervously as you set your weapon down on her lab bench. "It certainly has an… aura about it now, doesn't it." 


She picks it up gingerly. "I'll make the necessary adjustments to empower it further. But…" she continues, "we must be careful. This is not the type of power one should take lightly."


"The Revenants are ample evidence of that."

Queen Mara's eyebrows lift as you hand her the Ascendant Lens. "This is an exceedingly rare trinket," she says, peering at you through the lens.


"It may not look like much to a common Guardian, but in the hands of our Techeuns, it will be a valuable research tool. You were right to bring it to me."

entries.title: Renegades
entries.speaker: Armorer Aghol
entries.quote:
"Aghol. Totality Armorer. And you're the Lightbearer who's raised such a ruckus around the place."


The Armorer eyes you up and down. "Well, I don't mind a bit of a ruckus myself. There are plenty of abandoned drop pods scattered across Sol's old battlefields. Easy enough to recover and repurpose as artillery."


"Even Guardians know, nothing outside the pod survives contact with the pod." Aghol laughs loudly, and hands you a beacon.

entries.title: The Territory War Begins
entries.speaker: Armorer Aghol
entries.quote:
Aghol scratches his chin. "Looking for a Syndicate to ally with? I won't say we couldn't use you, Guardian. And you couldn't do better than the Totality Division.


"One thing about the Division is, Rao doesn't brook any nonsense. We won't mess with your Glimmer. We share resources accordingly. What am I gonna do with a Praxic Blade, cut my hand off? Any mods come in, they're earmarked for you-if you earn 'em."


"I'll see you back here soon, yeah?"

entries.speaker: Armorer Aghol
entries.quote:
Armorer Aghol clears his throat. "Got some more legalese for you, Lightbearer. You ready?"


"'The Totality Division is grateful for your continued support. The rewards promised you are being held in escrow by Spider. If you have any issues with the delivery, we request that you take it up with him. With regards from Enforcer Rao."


"Glad I don't have to write that stuff myself," Aghol says. "But we mean it."

        Asher thanks you for the work you've done in securing Io.

entries.quote:

        Asher thanks you for the significant progress you've made on Io.

entries.title: Evacuation: Io
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
As you relay Zavala's message to Asher, he grins dryly.


"He values my safety over documenting galaxy-saving knowledge? How noble," he says and waves away Zavala's concern. "If that is all the bureaucrat had to say, there are several tasks requiring your attention."


"Ikora told me of unusual Taken activity nearby, but I did not make it a priority. You must correct that oversight. In addition, an altered Taken roams the nearby caves. Fetch a sample so that I may probe it for Dark influence."


"Most importantly, venture into the Pyramidion and search for scan evidence. I believe the dark ships came here for the same reason as I."

entries.title: Fleischman-Aschheim Axiom
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
Asher studies the data you brought him. "I finally see," he says.


"If the Darkness claims the Pyramidion, it will dissect it for study. Unfold its innumerable dimensions, wade through its multitudinous seas radiozoic, peer through its crackling warp gates leading toward a million millions of new realities…"


Asher's voice drops low and quiet. "I will not allow it."


"If something steps out of that ship and descends down the pulsing electric corridors of the Pyramidion, through the infinite swirling Cantor dust of its interior…"


"They will find me in its heart. On the shores of my radiolarian lake."


Asher's arm emits a steady mechanical thrum.


"And I will be ready for them."

entries.title: Increase Reputation
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote: Show Asher Mir proof of your deeds on Io.

entries.title: Io Challenges
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote: You've done your part to secure Io, and Asher appreciates it. Even if he doesn't show it.

entries.title: Plotting a Downfall
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
Asher takes your data and enters it into his terminal with inhuman speed. The console emits a mechanical hum, then an incongruously cheerful chime.


"Novel stimulus yields novel data!" he cries, and his metallic arm spasms in agreement.


As he studies the readout, an inscrutable expression twists his face. "This pattern of interference, paired with the Taken behavior observed in the Festering Core… something is studying the Vex."


He looks toward the distant Pyramid. "There's a chess game being played here, and someone doesn't want us to see who wins."


"Continue your patrols," he says, waving you away. "I will send word if I have more time to dedicate to your mentorship."

entries.title: Precisely
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
"Ah, unchocolate," Asher says, taking the chocolate bar. "An acquired taste, to be sure, but so much better than those cloying chocolate coins…"


He sets the bar down. "I don't approve of this pointless scavenger hunt of yours. It's easy to laugh at death when you believe you're never going to die, isn't it?"

entries.title: Precisely
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
"The Festival of the Lost is not about masks and sweets," Asher says when you return. "You've known true loss, so you must know that."


After a contemplative pause, he hands you a stalk of celery. "Go on, then. Play your game, but don't let the levity of it fool you into forgetting what this tradition is truly about."

entries.title: Preparation: Io
entries.speaker: Asher Mir
entries.quote:
Asher Mir is working furiously at his terminal as you approach. Multicolored waveforms crash and collapse on the screen.


"There you are, assistant," he says. "I saw you earlier as you ran off after that ship."


"The denizens of this moon are reacting strangely to the Pyramid. Take to the field, record your actions, and bring me the data."


"I shouldn't have to tell you to hurry." He glances toward the black ship hanging in the sky, and his eyes narrow with irritation. "Time appears to be of the essence."

entries.title: A Guardian Rises
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee stands at a countertop meticulously inspecting an unfinished weapon.


"Oh. Hey. You new here?" he says gruffly.


"Don't think I've seen you around before. Then again, not good with faces."


He trails off, his attention back to some detail of the rifle in his hands. He regards you carefully for a moment.


"Oh, that's right, Commander told me you were coming. Asked me to get you set up. Got it on a note right here. Here. Take this. It's solid."


His eyes look past you for a moment before snapping back.


"Oh. Hey. Wait, we spoke already, right? Right. Stay safe."

entries.title: A Sacred Fusion
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 looks up from his toolbench when you get close. He smiles. "It's no secret you've been putting in the work down there," he says. "You more than deserve this."


He hands you a gleaming new weapon.


"I'm gonna keep working on some new looks for it," he says. "A gun that nice deserves some extra attention, don't you agree?"

entries.title: A Sacred Fusion
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 waves you over. "Got something interesting cooking up back there," he says. "Experimental tech. It'll be a little hot to handle."


"While I'm working on it, go make a name for yourself in the field. I want them to wonder where you get your guns. Head into strikes and Crucible and the other one that snake guy runs."


He seems lost in thought for a moment. "What's it called? Gamble?"


"Anyway, go in there and make a name for yourself," he says. "Then when they see you carrying that new piece, they'll know I don't hand 'em out to just anybody."

entries.title: Aftershock
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I trust my own expertise in crafting weapons. For expertise in their use, I turn to you." -Ada-1

entries.title: An Education
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Complete activities to prove your mastery of Eriana's Vow and Banshee will reward you with an Exotic weapon catalyst.

entries.title: An Old Flame
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Job well done. This dragon's ready to roar." -Banshee-44

entries.title: An Old Flame
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Haven't gotten my hands on one of these in a long time, but I can tell it's keen to get back into fighting trim. Want to see what it can do?" -Banshee-44

entries.title: And Out Fly the Wolves
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee spins a Wolfpack Round on his workbench, then stops it with his palm. "Perfectly balanced," he muses. "Not surprised. Crux really knew how to put these things together."


He looks up at you. "I wouldn't have thought forging a new Gjallarhorn was possible, but it seems that every day, the impossible gets a little closer."


He looks over at the vaults a few meters away, now brimming with the weapon stashes of countless Guardians. "We lost a lot in the Red War. The Fallen probably tucked what tech they could carry somewhere in the Cosmodrome. Check the old scav hangouts. Maybe Exodus Garden."


Banshee appears lost in thought for a moment. "Y'know, part of wielding the Gjallarhorn is honoring those who didn't make it. Parts should come from the armor of those we've lost… yeah. And we've lost a lot lately…"


He digs around under his table for a moment, then comes up with a battered trigger mechanism.


"I pieced this together a long time ago so I wouldn't forget some friends I had," he says, then looks down. "Didn't work. Maybe it's time to let go of the past, but still honor it."


He raps the tables with his metal knuckles. "Let's make this weapon one to remember."

entries.title: Another Last City
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I remembered where the name Arbalest came from… or at least I had remembered. Hmm, well take 'er for a spin. Maybe that'll jog my memory."

entries.title: Another Last City
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Arbalest… can't remember what this was named after. Either way, it's a handy weapon. You know what would help tune it just right? Getting some data from Neomuna. You up for it? "

entries.title: Any Data Port in a Storm
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"You know, once upon a time, we didn't put onboard AIs into our weapons." The grim Exo looks over the auto rifle. "Those were dark times. Things are much more interesting now." 


He sets to work, making minuscule adjustments to the auto rifle's frame. "Programs can do a lot, but sometimes you just need to get your hands in there…" 


The nanites apparently take his lead, because when he finally returns the weapon to you, the balance feels better, the weight adjusts in your hand to perfect levels as you hold it. Banshee's grin is wicked and joyful. "One last set of calibrations. Call it high-impact testing."

entries.title: Applied Cryptosecurity
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
It takes a moment for Banshee to remember why you've come to him with a more-or-less-functional key generator, but after a bit of kind prompting from Ghost, he gets there.


"Right, right," he mutters, rummaging through a pile of ammo cases and weapon parts on his work bench. He finds a small device which he uses to digitally sign your generator, and just like that, you've got a simple little program that can spit out a code that should open that case.


"Go see if it works," Banshee says gruffly.

entries.title: Armor Synthesis Introduction
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Folks are saying Ada-1's back? Don't remember her leaving," Banshee grumbles. His eyes narrow, but he doesn't stop repairing the Auto Rifle on his desk.


"Come to think of it, I guess I didn't see her for a while… anyway, I hear she's asking Guardians for help. Got some new project in the works, something about programmable matter… and Europa? The Fallen too… Hard to keep the details straight, but I'm glad she's keeping busy."


The servos in his hand whirr quietly as he works on the weapon.


"Maybe pay her a visit? Whatever she's making, I'm sure it's worth your time. She's always been a special talent."

entries.title: Banshee-44
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"I got a special relationship with loss. You know that." Banshee looks down at the gun he's polishing. "It's not easy, keeping spirits up during a holiday that's all about remembering."


He pauses, then looks up. "But those memories are in there somewhere. Deep down, maybe. So I try to honor them best I can, especially this time of year."

entries.title: Blade of Broken Dreams
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Head back to the Tower and speak to Banshee-44 about the broken blade.

entries.title: Blast from the Past
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee holds a slug shotgun in his hand, intricately ornamented and gleaming with polished metal. He rotates it, testing the weight distribution, then quickly spins it by the lever. A shell ejects as it lands back in his hands, pointed at you.


"Same as you ever were, old friend."


He lowers the barrel and inspects the weapon.


"This weapon was in Holliday's family a long time. Helped her make it to this city…"


"Look out for your friends, Guardian. This shotgun will help you do just that."

entries.title: Blast from the Past
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Didn't I ask Shaw to take care of this? Hmm, Holliday was right: 'delegate' might be his favorite word."


"Been trying to fix up an old family heirloom of Holliday's for a while now, something to remember her by. This'll help me calibrate the tooling. Only…"


Banshee wipes the grease from his forehead.


"Where did I put those charts? I'm going to need some time to crunch these numbers. Come back in a bit."

entries.title: Blast from the Past
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"A Holliday family schematic…"


Banshee's eyes shimmer.


"Holding this reminds me of those harebrained schematics Amanda used to create."


"I'll need to see how it performs in extreme temperatures. Europa might be a good spot to generate some data below freezing points. How about it?"

entries.title: Decrypting Resonant Elements
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Glad you were able to get those Resonant Elements outta those Prime Engrams. I know Rahool will do his best to get as many as he can from them each week."


"Though if you're anything like me, it's hard keepin' track of something like Resonant Elements all the time. I hear the Relic Tether on Mars is great for that." 


Banshee scratches his head. "Hm. Now where was I? …Anyways, appreciate the help today, Guardian."

entries.title: Decrypting Resonant Elements
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Hey, Guardian," Banshee says. "Been working with Master Rahool, our resident Cryptarch, to help you get Resonant Elements at the point of Prime Engram decryption. If you got any of those engrams, make sure you take 'em to him."


• Have Master Rahool decrypt a Prime Engram, and he will provide you with Resonant Elements up to a limit each week.

entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "This should give you an edge in the field," Banshee says. "Happy to help."

entries.title: Eight Count
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Not bad. Reminds me of a time I was tangling with this Vandal… or was it a Hive Knight?" Banshee's voice trails off. After a brief pause, he shakes his head.


"Cayde would probably remember better than me, he was there. Anyway, hope you learned something, Guardian."


You can find additional finishers at the Eververse store.

entries.title: Enhancing Weapons
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee looks pleased to see you and hands you the weapon that he's just finished polishing. 


"You've earned this, Guardian-a weapon capable of using Resonant Elements and being enhanced. After that, you may just want to take this beauty to that Relic in the Enclave. I bet it'll be even better once you reshape it with enhanced traits."

entries.title: Enhancing Weapons
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"I've heard that place called Neomuna has some interesting weapons like this. I'm not much for rumors most of the time, but…" Banshee shrugs. "When it comes to weapons, don't leave nothing to chance."


Weapon enhancement is a powerful tool. Keep gathering Resonant Elements, and you'll be able to build an arsenal of enhanced weapons that the Relic in the Enclave on Mars can reshape to your liking.

entries.title: Enhancing Weapons
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee inspects the weapon in his hands as you approach. "Don't make these like they used to," he says under his breath. His eyes flit toward you. 


"I bet you can appreciate how hard it is to wake up a gun sometimes." He looks down at the one he's holding and shakes his head. "Resonant Elements won't help this one. But for ones that can be enhanced? Makes a world of difference in a firefight-so keep your eyes peeled for those."


His eyes gleam with inspiration suddenly. "Take care of a few things for me, and then I'll show you what I mean-find you a weapon worthy of enhancing and reshaping."

entries.title: Enhancing Weapons
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Acquire a quest from Banshee-44 to learn about weapon enhancement.

entries.title: Exalting the Flame
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 briefly looks up from his work. "Zahn's always been a pain. Glad someone put him in his place."


"Sounds like you made an impression on Ikora. She asked me to find a Solar weapon for you." The weapon that he hands you looks untouched, fresh from the armory. "This can Scorch, just like you. Should play well with your armor and abilities."


When you don't immediately leave, Banshee speaks up once more. "Not often that Ikora puts in a request like this. If you want to keep learning, go back to her. I think she'll make time for you."


Check back with Ikora to continue learning about your Light, including other Aspects, abilities, Fragments, and keywords.

entries.quote: "Guardian. I found something I thought you'd find useful. Set it aside somewhere here. Let's see…"

entries.title: Forging Your Own Path
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 waves you over. "Got an interesting request for you here," he says. "I've got the rough specs for a weapon, but the particulars depend on how you gather the combat data."


"You can tackle this one your way: help Zavala with some strikes, do Crucible matches for Shaxx, or run through Gambit for that other guy."


Banshee-44 waves his hand. "I forget his name-smells funny, snakes on his clothes?"


"Anyway," he continues, "the weapon will come out the same no matter how you get the data, so just help whomever you like the most."


"Me, I'd go with Zavala. I don't know the Drifter, and that guy with the horns on his hat is just too loud."

entries.title: Grenade Logic
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 takes the Grenade Launcher from you and applies the catalyst.


"I had to do some real research into Hive stuff to figure out how to get it just right," he says.


"Saw some old names," he mutters. "Stirred up some old memories."


Work complete, he hands the weapon back to you with a wink.


"If you use that thing on Crota, tell him Banshee sent you."

entries.title: Grenade Logic
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"What are you doing?" Banshee-44 exclaims as you place the weapon before him. "You can't just take guns from the Hive and expect me to…"


He trails off as he picks up the weapon and turns it over in his hands. 


"Who's been working on this? Eris?" he wonders to himself. "She must have had Brya help."


He holds one of the dangling cards between his metal fingers and squints.


"These use Hive magic to keep the weapon intact, huh?" he says. "Smart. A little creepy, but smart."


Finally, he nods and hands the weapon back.


"You don't need to be a thanatonaut to see this thing has some deep ties to the other side. You want to earn its respect, you'll have to do a lot of killing, and not as much dying."

entries.title: Gunsmith Rank
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Think you can handle serious hardware? Prove it." 
-Banshee-44

entries.title: Heavy Does It
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Nice work, Guardian." Banshee-44 looks up from his workbench. He hands you the repaired catalyst. 


"All that Cabal tech you seized worked like a dream. It's fully operational, and ready for the field."


"Good luck out there. Not that you need it," he quips.

entries.title: Heavy Does It
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Cabal tech is twice as thick as it needs to be, and three times as heavy. Get your hands on some Cabal tech to finish this rebuild."
-Banshee-44

entries.title: Heavy Does It
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
