"But it needs to be rebuilt before you can use it in the field."


"Lucky for you," he continues, "I got a plan. All we need is some Cabal tech to study…"

entries.title: Heavy Does It
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Nice work, Guardian." Banshee-44 looks up from his workbench. He hands you the repaired catalyst. 


"All that Cabal tech you seized worked like a dream. It's fully operational, and ready for the field."


"Good luck out there. Not that you need it," he quips.

entries.title: Heavy Does It
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"This is a fine looking piece of Cabal scrap," Banshee-44 says, turning the catalyst over in his hands. 


"But it needs to be rebuilt before you can use it in the field."


"Lucky for you," he continues, "I got a plan. All we need is some Cabal tech to study…"

entries.title: Higher Voltage
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Looks like it worked," Banshee comments upon your return.


"Arcology's scientists were good, but they didn't have Guardians. Bet they never counted on channeling Arc Light through this thing."


He gives the weapon a final inspection, seemingly lost in thought.


"Heard about an old power source Sloane was carting around Titan for a time. Maybe this gun was meant to go with it."


Banshee shrugs as he hands the Centrifuse back to you.


"Guess we'll never know. Another memory, lost beneath the waves."

entries.title: Higher Voltage
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee examines the charred Centrifuse with a sharp eye.


"Impressive stuff," he mutters to himself before looking back to you.


"Cutting edge Golden Age tech. Some burnt out components, but… hmm…"


He crosses his arms in front of his chest and nods slowly to himself.


"Yeah. There's potential here. Need you to do some calibrating first, though."


Banshee hands the weapon back to you with a knowing expression.

entries.title: Illegal Trigger
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I trust my own expertise in crafting weapons. For expertise in their use, I turn to you." -Ada-1

entries.title: Impossible Rumors
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Look… I'm not gonna tell ya there are weapons out there more complex… more deadly than the greatest gunsmiths could design. But there's rumors of an outbreak on Titan and a worm on Io that packs more punch than a Titan on a bad day. Don't take my word for it. Ask around."


Incredible weapons exist in the wilds beyond the City. Follow clues and learn from your fellow Guardians to discover what is myth and what is real.

entries.title: In-Flight Benefits
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I trust my own expertise in crafting weapons. For expertise in their use, I turn to you." -Ada-1

entries.title: Increase Reputation
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Show the Gunsmith proof of your enthusiasm for destruction.

entries.title: Independent Study
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee is quiet for a while, then he says, "Say. I don't mind lookin' at this for you, but I'm gonna have to tell Ikora about it, all right?"


You nod. "You might as well throw this away and start from scratch," Banshee mumbles. "But… If you're really determined…"


By the time he sends you on your way with a detailed shopping list, he's forgotten the conversation entirely.

entries.title: Initial Calibration
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I trust my own expertise in crafting weapons. For expertise in their use, I turn to you." -Ada-1

entries.title: Initial Calibration
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "How did it go? No, no, don't tell me. The telemetry must speak for itself." -Ada-1

entries.title: Initial Calibration
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Your test results were invaluable in the development process. We make a good fireteam-is that how a Guardian would say it?" -Ada-1

entries.title: Initial Calibration
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "The Shotgun needs some adjustments. Come back anytime, Guardian." -Ada-1

entries.title: Initial Calibration
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Come back soon, Guardian. We have yet to perfect our Bow!" -Ada

entries.title: Into the Abyss
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 gives you a curious look. "Never understood anything Ikora said about the Void. But I know weapons, and she asked me to find one for you."


The weapon that he hands you looks untouched, fresh from the armory. "Let's say you debuff a target with Void. Drop them with this, and you'll get a Void barrier for protection. Should work well with your armor too."


He lapses into a thoughtful silence before speaking up again. "You're not bad at this, Guardian. But nobody knows everything. If you want to get better, ask Ikora to keep teaching you."


Check back with Ikora to continue learning about your Light, including other Aspects, Fragments, abilities, and keywords.

entries.title: Legacy: //CHOIR: ESCALATE
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Hard to think with someone else's words in your head." -Banshee-44

entries.title: Legacy: //CHOIR: ETERNAL
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "There's something down there. Something… singing." -Banshee-44

entries.title: Legacy: //CHOIR: UPHEAVAL
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I hear her voice… Can you hear it too?" -Banshee-44

entries.title: Lost Lament
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "This thing is givin' me flashes left and right. But they're scrambled. Something about a bunker hidden away among the ice. Must be Europa. Gotta ask you to help one more time. We're close, I can feel it."

entries.title: Lost Lament
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Bunch of Guardians storm the Deep Stone Crypt and next thing I know, I wake up in a daze sprawled out on the floor.


"Seems crazy to assume the two are connected, but then again, stranger things and all that, y'know?


"Now you walk in here and my insides go haywire all over again.


"Lotta weird images flashin' through my mind. Hard to make sense of 'em all. Vex… a blade… And a few dead Exos on Europa, unhappy with their lot in life, I imagine.


"Not sure what that's about. Maybe see about findin' 'em? Help me make sense of all this. I'll be waitin'."


-Banshee-44

entries.title: Lost Lament
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Well… that did it. I can see a bit clearer now. The thing-the big Exo head… It's me. And I'm… it. Both of us, Clovis Bray. Well that's… certainly something.


"I don't feel like the old man. But it's coming into focus more each minute.


"I know now I used that Sword to repel a takeover by the Vex during the Golden Age. Looks like you've done somethin' similar. No need to hand it over; it's yours now.


"Thanks for protecting, well, me. I think I'll be makin' a trip over there at some point. Visit my giant self. Learn more about who I was.


"I've got questions, and it sounds like I've also got answers. Hopefully I've got nothing left to answer for."

entries.title: Magnum Opus
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee stares silently at the weapon you place before him.


"Where did you…" he begins, but then stops. Carefully, he takes the incomplete weapon in his hands.


He tests its weight, its sights, considers the brutal efficiency of its design. "You've never brought me a piece like this before," he murmurs. "I'd remember."


Finally, he turns to you. "I can fix this," he says. "It won't be exactly how it was… I'll have to improvise. I don't know the make of any of these parts. I'm not even sure what kind of metal…"


He trails off again, then takes the weapon into the back of his shop.


"It'll shoot," he says when he reappears. "Thing'll kick like a warthog, but it'll shoot."


He hands you the sidearm with reverence. "A gun like that could make somebody a hero."


He chuckles. "Of course, it wouldn't hurt to be a hero to begin with."

entries.title: Magnum Opus II
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
You approach Banshee's work table with the Anomalous Weapon Part in your hand. Banshee reaches across and snatches it from you before you can say a word.


"Would you look at that," he marvels, inspecting the part. "There's only one weapon I've ever seen that matches this make. It's not the kind of piece you'd forget. Give me a minute, and I'll tune it up for you."


He disappears with the piece for a moment, then reappears, chuckling to himself. "This much power in a sidearm… I can hardly tell if this is the world's biggest pistol or the world's smallest rifle."


"Fine tune this in the field and you'll be legendary," he says with a wink. "Go get 'em, Guardian."

entries.title: Make Bows, Not War
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee looks up from his work as you approach. "Hey," he says. "Heard about the Moon. Nightmares. Vex." He shakes his head. "You're gonna want some, uh... Some real firepower for that."


His gaze loses focus for a moment, then he goes on. "Got somethin' in my workshop that I want you to have. Ain't a gun. Big Bow. It'll chew up those Vex real good. You go on up to my workshop, take a look at it. See if you like it. Cayde'll tell ya where the secret entrance is."


Another customer queues behind you. Best get going.

entries.title: Meet Banshee-44
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"It's always nice to meet a new Guardian. As a welcome to the Tower, here… take this weapon. Trust me. It's an upgrade."


Banshee-44 is the Tower's Gunsmith. He offers bounties, gear mods, and special rewards.


Hover over the weapon icon below, and select it with .


ACQUIRE WEAPON

entries.title: Messy Business
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee-44 lifts the launcher for you to take. "See what you think. I tweaked it. Snappy and quick. Don't thank me, the work occupies… If anything, I should be thanking you."

entries.title: Messy Business
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 tunes an unfinished weapon frame as you approach him. "Lot of things coming to light recently. Maybe it's best to put it out of your head and focus on the simple things."


Banshee looks up from his work. "Get everything in tune before moving forward, you know? Here's your kit. Keep em on their heels."

entries.title: New Enhancements
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Let's see," Banshee says, leaning against the counter. "I think I could give this weapon a boost for you. Something to help you out in the field."


He nods. "But first, I need to see how you handle it. Get me some data, and I'll see what I can do."

entries.title: Nightfall
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Guardian. I found something I thought you'd find useful. Set it aside somewhere here. Let's see…"

entries.title: Nightfall: The Ordeal
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Guardian. I found something I thought you'd find useful. Set it aside somewhere here. Let's see…"

entries.title: No Trespassing
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"That catalyst polished up real nice," Banshee says. 


He hands it back to you and asks, "Who did the work?"


Ghost starts to answer, but Banshee's attention wanders to work on other weapons.


"See you around," he says.

entries.title: No Trespassing
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"This came in for you. Tech is Fallen. Could ask, uh… Splicers-yeah."


Banshee looks proud and then flips the piece over. "Wait… no. Forgot about this."


Banshee pulls a pin from the frame of the catalyst. He holds it up to looks at it. It lights up and emits a tiny projection of Calus.


"Welcome to my little game of tribute," the projection says. "If you want your treasure, you'll have to pay in blood."


"You are a trespasser in my home, just as the Fallen trespass in your home. Rid your home of the trespassers, and my gift will be yours."


The projection finishes with booming laughter and shuts off.


"Huh," grunts Banshee.

entries.title: Nock, Draw, Loose, Quiet
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 takes the Verglas Curve from you and applies the catalyst.


"It's not as complex as the system a compound bow has," he explains as he restrings the weapon, "but it should give you a little extra kick."


He finishes, then lets his hands linger for a moment on the dark wood.


"There's something honest about a weapon built like this," he says. 


"Take good care of it."

entries.title: Nock, Draw, Loose, Quiet
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
As you place the Verglas Curve in front of Banshee-44, a look of confusion crosses his face.


"Hey, look. I said I could improve your new weapon, but I didn't know it was…" he trails off as he picks up the bow and eyes it skeptically. 


"Is this made of… wood?"


He runs his metal fingers over the bowstring and delicate ferns of frost sprout from the tension. 


"Oh. Stasis," he grumbles. "I heard about Guardians using some kind of yarn power… well, at least I understand this." 


"Okay," he says with a shrug, "if you can shoot it, I can improve it. Any catalyst for this weapon would have been lost long ago, so we'll have to recreate one." 


He hands the bow back to you. "Take it to the field and let's figure out how it works."

entries.title: One Last Job
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Some guns need to finish what they started long ago. You're just along for the ride." -Banshee-44

entries.title: One Way, Many Paths
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 takes your combat data and returns with a gleaming rifle.


"I forgot to check whom you sided with, Guardian," he says, then chuckles. "It's kinda funny. Whomever you pick, you come back to me, right?"


"I guess everybody needs a weapon. That piece oughta do you good wherever you're headed next."

entries.title: Pain and Gain
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Got a weapon frame here you might like, but its pain matrix is on the fritz. Seems like trouble. Hmm…


"Had a friend who'd say 'trouble's the point.' He had a chicken and a sense of humor. Anyway...


"Have your Ghost track the thresholds of the punishment you take out in the wilds so we can fine-tune its systems to channel and redirect your, uhh… discomfort."


Follow the quest steps to complete the objectives as Banshee-44 helps you construct a powerful Exotic weapon.

entries.title: Points Piercing Forever
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"That's all the energy this thing needs," nods Banshee-44 as he hands you the completed catalyst. "Let me tell you, I think there's something funny about this bow. It messes with my internal chronometer."


"It feels like that thing was meant for your hands. Like it always belonged there."

entries.title: Points Piercing Forever
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"I've got a catalyst for that bow of yours," Banshee-44 says. "I think I've always had it, but I don't remember getting it."


"Charge the catalyst with energy and I'll work on it for you… but next time, can you just bring me a regular gun? Nothing that collapses timelines or whatever?"

entries.title: Prototype Tuning: Bowstring
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Thanks to you, I know just where to add the nocking point. I appreciate your help, Guardian." -Ada-1

entries.title: Prototype Tuning: Magazine
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Thanks to you, I got incredible data. If you got any closer, they would start blushing." -Ada-1

entries.title: Prototype Tuning: Traits
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Thanks to you, I got incredible data. If you got any closer, they would start blushing." -Ada-1

entries.title: Prototype Tuning: Traits
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Thanks to you, I know just where to add the nocking point. I appreciate your help, Guardian." -Ada-1

entries.title: Reach Level 20
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Increase your level to claim these rewards.

entries.title: Remembrance
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Never liked the Moon. Too many memories. Too many lost friends. Hate to see you end up the same… And I know you've walked where most wouldn't dare, but there's always lessons to learn, Guardian. Even some you think you already know."


Heed Banshee's words. Do as he asks, and earn an Exotic weapon catalyst for the Eriana's Vow Hand Cannon.

entries.title: Resonant Smithing
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Nice work, you've earned these Resonant Elements. I can only get my hands on so many each week. You can use you Relic Tether to check how many I've got left."


"Stick around a few moments and I'll teach you how you can earn more of those Resonant Elements. Not to mention how to put those things to good use."

entries.title: Resonant Smithing
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"You've been doing some gunsmithing of your own, haven't you?"


The Exo stares you down sternly.


"Nice. I'm not sure how you do it exactly, but Rahool mentioned these things are at the root of it."


Banshee flashes a couple Resonant Elements.


"Do some bounties for me, and I'll throw in a few of these."

entries.title: Resonant Smithing
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Acquire the quest from Banshee-44 to learn how to earn Resonant Elements for use in weapon shaping.

entries.title: REVISION 7.2.2
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Hear me out," Banshee says as he slams part of a jumpship drive and a datapad on the counter. "Your gun uses a Lorentz focuser to channel energized particles, so does this old Echo-class jump drive. Before it blew up. Unrelated."


"If we mod your gun with these drive components, we'll be able to give it a lot more…" Banshee says before slamming his fist down on the counter. Then he just stares vacantly for a moment and asks, "What're you doing here? Oh, right. Hear me out," Banshee says. "Your gun uses a Lorentz focuser to…"


You take the jump drive parts and the datapad before Banshee goes through his plan all over again.

entries.title: REVISION 7.2.2
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Huh, look at that," Banshee says with an approving nod. "Linear modulator's looking good, thermal caster is intact, joints to the intake valves are nice and solid. Heck, this looks like as good a job as I'd do."


Banshee stares down at the catalyst, eyes slowly narrowing. "Wait, did I do this? Somebody did." He looks around, furtively, then slides you the catalyst.


"I don't know where I got this, but I think it'll work in your gun," Banshee says without any recognition in his eyes. "Here, take it."

entries.title: Shaped Weapon Level Boosting
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
As you approach, Banshee waves you over and puts aside his latest project. 


"Guardian. Saw you've been collecting those Resonant Elements. Do yourself a favor sometime and use 'em to improve your weapon directly for a quick boost." He scratches his head. "Should work pretty well with one of them Shaped weapons." 


• Resonant Elements you collect can be used for more than Deepsight activation. They can improve your weapon's level directly; this is called weapon level boosting. Careful, though, as the higher the level, the more Resonant Elements it will cost. Take some Resonant Elements and try leveling one of your Shaped weapons.

entries.title: Shaped Weapon Level Boosting
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
While final blows with your weapon and activity completion will level the weapon, weapon level boosting using Resonant Elements will help you unlock additional reshaping options faster.


However, the more you level your weapon, the more expensive it will get.

entries.title: Shaped Weapon Level Boosting
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Acquire the quest from the Gunsmith to learn about weapon level boosting.

entries.title: Should You Choose to Accept It, Part IV
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee looks down at the components laid out in front of him. He doesn't even pick one up, but there's a look of recognition in his eyes; distant and intense.


"They found something on the Moon…" he says, distractedly. "K1 anomaly. Smells like wet soil." He shakes his head, picking up one of the components.


"Nice parts," Banshee says with sudden clarity. "I can put these together for you, no problem."

entries.title: Sight, Shoot, Repeat
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "MIDA. MIDA. Old name. Almost as old as me. Lost a bunch of my schematics when the Tower went down. Could recreate one for you. If that's the kind of thing you're into." -Banshee-44

entries.title: Spare Parts
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee eyes you with a skeptical stare.


"Huh? I don't remember asking you to do this…"


He shrugs. "Oh, well. Everything helps, I guess. Thanks for your work."

entries.title: Speak with Banshee
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee thinks he can help boost your weapon's performance, but he needs you to do some work in the field first.

entries.title: Stasis Trigger
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
You overhear Banshee-44 talking to himself as you approach.


"Never saw a gun like that before," he says quietly. "Thing would go cold in your hands. Nothing good can come from a piece like that."


"Hey, Guardian," he says as he notices you. "Do me a favor: you ever find a Sidearm that runs cold, you be sure to keep this catalyst far away from it, y'hear?"


He holds up a damaged Sidearm catalyst.


"'Course, thing's busted pretty bad now. I'd need plenty of calibration data to get it up and running again."


"Get me some, would you?"

entries.title: Stasis Trigger
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 shivers as he holds the calibrated catalyst.


"There was some gun I was supposed to keep this away from," he says. "Something cold and dark. Can't really remember, though."


"Now that it's fully calibrated, maybe you could hold onto it to keep it safe."


His face brightens. "It might fit that Sidearm you've got there, in fact!"


Banshee-44 tosses you the catalyst, thanks you for your help, and goes back to polishing his weapons.

entries.title: Symmetry Remastered
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee takes a look at your gun and nods his approval. "I like the look of this one," he says. "But I bet I can help you kick it up a notch."


He leans back and crosses his arms. "Let me know if you want my help."

entries.title: Symmetry Remastered
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "This should help you get that extra edge I was talkin' about," Banshee says. "Not that you need it."

entries.title: Symmetry Remastered
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Let's see," Banshee says, leaning against the counter. "I think I could give this weapon a boost for you. Something to help you out in the field."


He nods. "But first, I need to see how you handle it. Get me some data, and I'll see what I can do."

entries.title: Taming the Storm
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 seems to be expecting you. "So you're the one who blew up that old Servitor? Good riddance, that thing's better off as scrap."


"Got something for you. Ikora said you needed an Arc weapon." The weapon that he hands you looks untouched, fresh from the armory. "This can jolt, just like you. Should play well with your armor and abilities."


Banshee goes back to his work, but not without a parting word. "Bit of advice, Guardian. Get used to seeing Ikora if you want to keep learning." 


Check back with Ikora to continue learning about your Light, including learning about other Aspects, Fragments, abilities, and keywords.

entries.title: Technical Knockout
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Don't let this gig fool you; I like the feel of a trigger under my finger, but sometimes ammo's short. Gotta find other ways to get the job done. Make sure you're prepared when that time comes."


Banshee encourages you to defeat enemies using your finisher.

entries.title: The Bank Job
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Banshee-44 wants to speak with you about the history of the Witherhoard.

entries.title: The Bank Job
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Some guns need to finish what they started long ago. You're just along for the ride." -Banshee-44

entries.title: The Fall Will Kill You
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Almost got it. Still need. Huh. Kind of a strange one. Still need some more data. For the tracker. Keep an open mind." -Banshee-44

entries.title: The Fall Will Kill You
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "That's it. Had to pare down some of the weirder features. Still works as a stellar sextant, cable splitter, avionics trawl, pneumatic drill, compass aligner... anyway. Enjoy the gun part." -Banshee-44

entries.title: The Form of the Danger
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 takes your Delicate Tomb and, after a few moments, installs and calibrates the catalyst.


"That should do it," he says, but his mechanical brow furrows. 


"Touching that weapon again… I don't know why, but I don't feel good about making it stronger." He hands you the gun, but as you take it, he holds his grip for a moment and looks into your eyes.


"I know you can handle anything, Guardian," he says, "but some things might be better forgotten."


He releases the gun and goes back to his business.

entries.title: The Form of the Danger
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 looks at your Delicate Tomb and whistles.


"Nice-lookin' weapon, Guardian," he says. He takes it from you and tests its weight. "Very-"


A strange look crosses the Exo's face. "Huh," he says quietly, "thought I heard something."


"Anyway," he says as he quickly hands the weapon back to you, "it's old construction, not anything I recognize, but I might know a way to tune it up."


He sends you back out into the field.

entries.title: The Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Seen the trophy yet?" Banshee asks as you approach his counter. "Zavala asked me to make it for the Games."


He shrugs. "I don't much care who wins. But I like seeing the Tower all dressed up and everyone talkin' about something other than doomsday. It's nice." He nods. "Anyway. Happy, uh…" He pauses, clearly struggling to remember. "Happy… Revelry, Guardian."

entries.title: The Heart's Depths
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "I remembered where the name Arbalest came from… or at least, I had remembered. Hmm, well take 'er for a spin. Maybe that'll jog my memory."

entries.title: The Heart's Depths
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Arbalest… can't remember what this was named after. Either way, it's a handy weapon. You know what would help tune it just right? Getting some data from inside the Traveler's Pale Heart. You up for it?"

entries.title: The Queen Beckons
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
The gears turn in Banshee's head. Distant connections solidify into recognition.


"Right, let's see what you learned in the Throne World."


Banshee tinkers away at the workbench behind him, slowly turning with a completed weapon.


"Sweet, now back to business."

entries.title: The Queen Beckons
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee is distant, taking far too long to notice your presence.


"Hm? Schematic? Yeah. Calibrate. Throne World."

entries.title: The Vow
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Eriana went to the Moon. Many did. None came back. Well… Eris did. But that wasn't 'til later. And she came back… different.


"My point's not about the loss though. Point is they went. Despite the odds. Despite the unknown.


"Eriana may be gone, but that gun means she's still with us. Still able to teach Guardians lessons worth learnin'."

entries.title: The Vow
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: Complete activities to prove your mastery of Eriana's Vow and Banshee will reward you with an Exotic weapon catalyst.

entries.title: The Vow
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Never liked the Moon. Too many memories. Too many lost friends. Hate to see you end up the same… And I know you've walked where most wouldn't dare, but there's always lessons to learn, Guardian. Even some you think you already know."


Heed Banshee's words. Do as he asks, and earn an Exotic weapon catalyst for the Eriana's Vow Hand Cannon.

entries.title: Tungsten Bowstring
entries.speaker: Banshee-44

entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
"Riskrunner's a real piece of work. Having a gun that gets aggressive when you're in a bad spot's a life saver. Sure, it may hurt a bit, but once that beauty gets humming, your enemies better watch out."


Your Riskrunner is complete. Use it on your journey to help shift the odds in your favor when the going gets tough.

entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Good job. Veist knows what they're about. But so do you." -Banshee-44

entries.title: Volantes Violentiam
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee-44 takes your Manticore and considers it carefully.


"Got some old parts," he says, deep in concentration. "I remember-what was it? It was a long time ago."


He shakes his head as if trying to shake a thought from his mind. The Exo hands the weapon back to you with a look of resolve.


"Won't be too hard to punch it up. No reason we have to settle for what's given."

"Looks like some things can come back even better than they were before," Banshee-44 says as he processes your data and feeds the results into the Duality.


"Wish it could be that easy for all of us."

entries.title: Weapon Deepsight Activation
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote: "Hey, Guardian. Got this weapon here for you, but you should know-it don't have Deepsight. Might work better with it, though. You get me some Resonant Elements, I'll see what I can do to help you activate this weapon."

entries.title: Weapon Deepsight Activation
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee nods as you approach. "Hey, Guardian. Wanted to make sure you knew that your Resonant Elements can be used to activate Deepsight on weapons-even those that don't have it."


"You set up that Deepsight activation, you can make Weapon Pattern progress with it."


"I'll find you something to test it out; would ya do a quick job for me while I get it?"

entries.title: Weapon Deepsight Activation
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee looks over your handiwork. "Not bad at all. You keep using your Resonant Elements for Deepsight activation, and you'll get more Weapon Patterns. And with more Patterns, you'll be shaping more weapons at that Relic in the Mars Enclave in no time."


"Just don't go expecting anyone to start callin' you the Gunsmith anytime soon." He winks and gives you an appreciative nod.

entries.title: Weapon Deepsight Activation

entries.title: Well Earned

entries.quote: "This should help you get that extra edge I was talkin' about," Banshee says. "Not that you need it."

entries.title: Where Are the Keys, Sir
entries.speaker: Banshee-44
entries.quote:
Banshee's pleased that you want the heavy Bow in his workshop. "Good," he says. "Real good. Uh. Problem is, though, lock on that case is real secure. Haven't opened it since we won the war against Ghaul. Not sure I even know where the keycodes are."


He contemplates a moment. "Well. That's all right. We can reverse engineer 'em. I'd say crack the glass, but…" He trails off. There is an ominous look in his eyes. "I don't recommend crackin' the glass."


He gives Ghost a number of diagnostics to generate a new keycode, and then sends you on your way.

Calus speaks through it, as ever. He alludes vaguely to something that he saw out at the edge of the universe during his exile, something that he calls "the truth of the universe."


You'll need to cultivate a greater sense of appreciation for such truths. Perhaps if you spend more time with the Emperor, you'll learn more.

Benedict stops sweeping and turns to face you. "His Highness sends his good wishes for you at this celebrated time of year," he says. "The Great Emperor rejoices in the overwhelming inevitability of death and is pleased that the Guardian-tribe does the same."

entries.title: Rein It In
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
Benedict's eye pulses red in syncopated rhythm, solidifying upon your approach.


"You'll be pleased to know your efforts were not in vain and the weapon has been located. Emperor Calus would be satisfied if you could cavort to the Quarry Lost Sector (Legendary) in the EDZ to recover it. In celebration of his decadence, indulge in a merciless spree of Red Legion desecration. Spread delight in his Eminence's name."

entries.title: The Invitation
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
Calus is pleased by your swift progress, but the potential of the Chalice of Opulence far exceeds your efforts today.


Only by entering Calus's Menagerie on the Leviathan will you begin to unlock its true abilities.

entries.title: The Invitation
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
As Calus speaks through Werner 99-40's stolen body, the frame offers you a fragmented Chalice.


Calus invites you to restore the Chalice, a symbol of power for his Shadows-elite Imperial assassins, the epitome of their respective alien races.

entries.title: The Invitation

entries.quote: "Scanning Tower inventory lists… Seems like another maintenance frame went on the fritz and disappeared from the Hangar a day or two ago." -Ghost

entries.title: Under Our Nose
entries.speaker: Benedict 99-40
entries.quote:
Steam emanates from the head of the frame as its piercing red eye raises to meet yours.


"Ah, Guardian. The Exalted One anticipated your cooperation in his grand design. With his infinite wisdom, he requests your assistance in furthering his machinations. His Excellency intended to use the weapon to eliminate Red Legionnaires. It seems you share a mutual goal."


Benedict's body turns and resets.


"Unfortunately, the Shadow you seek has been disposed of. Calus's insubordinate daughter, Caiatl, dispatched a countermeasure-much to the Glorious One's displeasure. The weapon is lost. I can compile the data you've brought me of the deceased Shadow's log, but it is heavily encrypted. Encryption signals point toward the EDZ. Perhaps you can perform some… unscrambling?"

entries.title: A Brother's Guidance
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Vance is studying his scrolls when you return.


"Osiris, the Forest, the Pyramid," he says. "There are connections here that go beyond simple prophecy-"


He stops abruptly, then whispers in the silence.


"As Guardians fall in the Trials, this Lighthouse chimes a dirge. Can't you hear it? Here, in the shadow of the Pyramid, the tones have grown richer."


He tilts his head for a moment, his mouth held in an open smile.


"There. It is the song of life and death."


Knowing there is much to be done, you leave Vance to his studies.

entries.title: Ascendant Lens
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Queen Mara's eyebrows lift as you hand her the Ascendant Lens. "This is an exceedingly rare trinket," she says, peering at you through the lens.


"It may not look like much to a common Guardian, but in the hands of our Techeuns, it will be a valuable research tool. You were right to bring it to me."


"Allow me to repay your generosity," she says, handing you a handsome reward.


You start to thank her, but she's already walking away. You've been dismissed.

entries.title: Better Days Ahead
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Brother Vance listens to your report with great interest. When you are finished, he smiles serenely.


"You have done me a great kindness," he says. "I regret I cannot join you in the City."


For a long moment, he stands peacefully in his cluttered sanctuary.


"I met Osiris once," Vance says. "'Write music,' he told me-among other things."


"The sacred tones came from the Lighthouse. The words are my own-no, not the tale of Osiris. My song is not one of worship, but one of hope, shining brightly in the dark."


"I will walk into the Infinite Forest and spread hope, Guardian."


His gives you a beatific smile.


"Hope for the future."

entries.quote:
Panoptes is gone, but much of the Forest is still under Vex control.


The Infinite Forest is… well, suffice to say, infinite. There are many more mysteries still to discover among its uncountable branches.

entries.title: Evacuation: Mercury
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Brother Vance recognizes your footsteps and brightens as you enter his sanctum.


"I believe I could refine traces of Osiris," he says with hushed excitement, "to allow one entrance to the Infinite Forest. There was a time I could not contemplate such an honor."


"Quantum cracks yawn in the Forest where echoes of Vex, Hive, Cabal, and Osiris swirl in a gyre. Strike these stress points, and I could seal the Forest from within."


You notice Vance's hands are balled tightly at his sides.


"The Pyramids draw close. Through this system and beyond, the Lightless are filled with fear. I am no Osiris, true, but in my small way, I will bring light to their darkness."


There is clarity in his voice. "I will tell them they must believe."

He turns back to his opened book, brushing his fingers over the pages. "The Forest is strange to me at this time of year. The wiser I am, the more Osiris's plans seem to evade me. I suppose that is the way."

entries.title: Preparation: Mercury
entries.speaker: Brother Vance
entries.quote:
Brother Vance is running his fingers over his books when you arrive. You tell him of Zavala's concern.


He nods. "I will attempt to divine which prophesized end-time we find ourselves in."


Vance traces an arcing hypotrochoid spiral on a thick piece of parchment. "Osiris used obscene amounts of Fractaline to power the obelisks," he says, shaking his head at the paradoxes the old Warlock tempted.


"Now I feel this taut reality tremble and groan. It anchors countless timelines, all pulling against the chronological center. And this Pyramid threatens to collapse them all."


"The Infinite Forest is the key to all of this," he says. "How, I do not yet understand. Any help you could provide would be most welcome."

We can't call in the big guns for this one. Gotta keep it quiet. So how's about you, me, and Crow go track it down and take it out? Quietly, remember."

entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-so here I am again, back in the EDZ. I know, I know. I said I would leave the Shard alone, but there is something about it. I am not the type that goes fishing for answers, but it feels like this place holds them. Like the Traveler is trying to tell us something. Ahh, what am I talking about, its probably just all those Arc storms messing with my insides-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
I should've paid more attention to you, Ikora. My brain usually checks out when the words have more than three syllables. Who would've known you can't shoot your way out of a Vex teleporter? When I get out of this mess whaddya say you lay some Vex schooling on me?


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-This Ishtar gig is pretty wild, even for a lughead like me. Get it, Ace. Lughead. Come on. I'm trying. I'll get some better jokes, I promise. I knew I was here to secure some top-secret thing in the jungle, but I saw it today. They dug up the remains of a technological civilization that actually predates humanity. Don't tell anyone I told you, or you know, could be wipesville again.-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-I've tried everything, Ace. Tried re-rigging my Ghost's shell every which way, making a deal with Variks for one of his captured Ghosts, even thought about following Ikora to Io, then it hit me. I can end this real quick by hopping right on Gary's ship via some Vex trickery. So here I am. Nessus, my own little Vex playground. Here goes nothing-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-Things are even weirder now, Ace. This is my fourth assignment, and I am kind of losing touch with what came before this whole Exo thing and what's a leftover fragment from another tour. I knew this would have had its kinks; I guess this is one of them. You know me, I didn't bother reading the fine print, or anything. At least I know, you're real, right?-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

-from the journals of Cayde-6

-couldn't tell you what it was, Ace, but it was trying to seize control of me, like I was nothing but circuits and steel. Didn't know who it was messing with. I guess the moral of that story is never fall asleep near anything marked with that symbol-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.quote:
-what can I say, I was just in too deep, Ace. I had to do something. For your sake, above all. I had lost any hope of cashing in, and to be honest, that big payday wasn't coming, not with the jobs I was finding, so when I got word of what was going on out there-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-This has been fun, I guess. But it will all be gone tomorrow. I have been what they call "compromised," which is funny because I feel fine. Could use a few upgrades, but what Exo couldn't. But "compromised" means they are going inside my brain to wipe it from my memory. Met an interesting fellow Exo who leaves letters like this in caches, so whatever she gets saddled with next, she might come across one and take a trip down "lost memory lane." Ace, know that when I find you, I will never let them find me-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote: Eden Story 4 Vendor Flavor Text

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-and if you see Satomi, make sure she knows the deal. Speaker thinks he's onto something, and those Arcstriders know every Dead Zone. And Cayde, don't make me remind you again. You lost fair and square. When you come back, this seat is yours. 


Your old pal and soon-to-be-relieved boss,


-Andal

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-so there you have it, Ace, that's why I did what I did. I had no choice, really. It was that or the great beyond. Just know your dad did what he had to do if I ever wanted to see you and your mother again. You probably won't recognize me, since I'll be, well, a robot and all, but I'll find you, I promise-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-I know, it's hard to believe. Someone with a sense of humor even more beloved than mine. But that's Sagira for you. I gotta say, Ace, I don't know what her secret is. To be attached to a blowhard like Osiris for that many years and not lose your smile? Pretty impressive. Some days it feels like I'm Zavala's Ghost. Chained to him like I'm a magnificent sailing vessel and he's a frowny blue anchor. And-


-From the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-what can I say, Ace, you should've seen me. I got each and every one of them out of there. That gang of Fallen raiders, gone, courtesy of yours truly. I can get used to this superhero stuff. Even got a few big wet ones from these really cute twins. DO NOT tell your mother-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.quote:
-Gotcha, Tevis! You scoundrel. Caught you red-handed! I knew it as soon as I saw that Ice Breaker on your back. I know where I left it and I saw those awful etchings you can't help but carve into trees. So put it back and walk away from this one, and whatever you do, DO NOT read my notes. Well, read this one but that's it! Nothing else!-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-so I thought the Reef would hold some answers for me. They've got some kind of Queen out there who knows things. But getting to her is proving to be quite the jaunt. She's got me chasing Vex all across the system looking for something called the Vault of Glass. Whaddya say, Ace, ever heard of it?-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-Whatever's going on down there, Ace, they don't want folks to know about it. But that's the job, so I'll do whatever it takes to find out. Might need a disguise. Hmm? Any ideas, Ace? Ooh! I know! How about a mustache?-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Mementos from the Wild
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
-Here's the truth, Ace. I don't remember you. Found your name in a journal I had on me when my Ghost rezzed me. I guess I used to write to you? And I kept doing it. Even though you're long dead, if you ever really existed. Just liked having someone to write to, I guess. So there you have it. Now, you'll never guess what happened today, Ace-


-from the journals of Cayde-6

entries.title: Patrols
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Hey there, Guardian.



        With the patrol network back online, the Vanguard can monitor enemy activity across the system and dispatch Guardians to where they are needed most. 


Each week, complete public events on the Flashpoint world to earn valuable rewards.

entries.title: Patrols
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Hey there, Guardian.



        With the Vanguard reunited, Zavala has prioritized re-establishing a network of patrol beacons to coordinate Guardian efforts across the system. He gave this task to Cayde-6, who would totally do it, except he has a bunch of other really important things going on. Vanguard things. So, you know. It falls to you. 


Travel to the European Dead Zone and complete the "Importance of Networking" activity.

entries.title: The Red War
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Hi Guardian



        Cayde went on his lone adventure and came back with one revelation: adventures are better (and safer) shared with partners. He's itching to get back out there and dig up more trouble and treasure-and wants you to watch his back. 


Swing by Cayde's corner for more treasure-hunting with a dash of roguish charm.

entries.title: Unnamed Interaction
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian,



        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Wild Card
entries.speaker: Cayde-6
entries.quote:
Cayde hears your approach and turns to you. He's holding a sniper rifle. While familiar in shape, its design certainly feels like Cayde has had his hands on it. He offers it to you.


"You didn't think I'd give Crow something and not cook up something for you too, right? Come onnnn," he says. "He got a shiny new cloak and, potentially, crushing responsibility. It's only fair that you get a new gun courtesy of yours truly."


Cayde crosses his arms and considers you for a moment. It feels as though the quiet is intentional, appreciating your presence, until he nods his head and pulls himself back to reality.


"It was nice gettin' into trouble with you again," he says, words laced with sincerity that lingers despite how quickly he tries to move on.


"Now, I've gotta go figure out how to get the rest of this Screeb juice out of my clothes before the big battle." Cayde sniffs his cloak, still rancid from the Screeb slime, and recoils. He whispers, "…At this point, I might just burn 'em."

entries.title: A Guardian Rises
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"I see you've finished your rounds. These people are invaluable resources for your journey as a Guardian. You would do well to remember that as you take your next steps.


"Speaking of which, I have your first assignment. Shaw has successfully tracked down Navôta in the Cosmodrome; I'm authorizing a strike operation to eliminate her, and I want you to on it.


"Navôta is responsible for the death of two fellow Guardians. We cannot allow her to cull any more from our ranks. I'm trusting you and Shaw to get the job done.


"Good luck, Guardian."

entries.title: A Guardian Rises
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala welcomes you to your new home: the Last City.


He encourages you to continue meeting the residents of the Tower and informs you that there's a gift waiting for you in his office.

entries.title: A Guardian Rises

"Navôta is responsible for the death of two fellow Guardians. We cannot allow her to cull any more from our ranks. I'm trusting you and Shaw to get the job done.


"Good luck, Guardian."

entries.title: A Guardian Rises
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala offers a small smile. "I hope you found the Tower accommodating."


His eyes harden. "I've got news. The Hive Wizard you and Shaw were pursuing-we've pinpointed her location in the Cosmodrome. If you're able and willing, we need a Guardian on the ground. Shaw offered to run support."


"Accept this mission, and you're in. You fly your first strike as a Guardian. Eyes up."

entries.title: A Looming Threat
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Ana believes Rasputin can help destroy the Almighty before it hits the City. He's reluctant to trust the Warmind, but asks you to go to Mars to speak with Ana.

entries.title: A New Tradition
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Welcome, Guardian," Zavala says as you approach. "My friend Eva Levante was kind enough to remind me that, even in times of crisis, people need levity and Light.


"And so I've proposed a new holiday: the Guardian Games. This is an opportunity for Titans, Warlocks, and Hunters to compete and demonstrate their unique strengths."


He hands you a piece of gear. "Wear this proudly. It will help you contribute to your class's score." He smiles. "And good luck, Guardian."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Exemplary work, Guardian. Strikes are an important component in our defense of humanity. As of now, I'm approving you for our full range of strike protocols; we're always in need of more fireteams ready to take the fight to the enemy's door."


Zavala holds one hand against the other palm.


"There are other matters at hand, however. We've analyzed the superconductor, and it's exactly what we hoped for. We believe it can be used to reconstruct a powerful Arc weapon; a salvaged piece of Golden Age technology."


"Ikora led the research efforts; she's waiting for you now. Good luck."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Riskrunner suits you, Guardian. I had planned to add it to the Tower's vault, but based on your performance, I think the only suitable place for it is in your hands.


"Weapons like this are the backbone of our arsenal. As you continue your journey, you would be wise to seek out other remarkable assets.


"Only by combining our Light with the most powerful of armaments can we hope to succeed against the forces of Darkness. Remember that, Guardian."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:

"Weapons like this are the backbone of our arsenal. As you continue your journey, you would be wise to seek out other remarkable assets.


"Only by combining our Light with the most powerful of armaments can we hope to succeed against the enemies of humanity. Remember that, Guardian."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala

Zavala holds one hand against the other palm.


"Now it's time for you to commemorate your success. You're ready for the next Guardian Rank. The ceremony starts at the tree behind you."


Zavala smiles.


"Don't delay."

entries.title: A Spark of Hope
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala's gaze is weighty, a mixture of pride, worry, and hope.


"Congratulations on reaching the second Guardian Rank. If you ever lack clarity on what to do next, the Ranks offer constructive guidance."


"There are two important tasks ahead of you. First, the superconducter. Completed analysis tells us it's exactly what we hoped for. We believe it can be used to reconstruct a powerful Arc weapon; a salvaged piece of Golden Age technology."


"Ikora Rey led the research efforts; she'll brief you on the specifics."

entries.title: All Clear
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Shock tactics are an important tool for the Vanguard," Zavala says. "The aural and optical devastation of a large ordnance provides a significant tactical advantage and wreaks havoc on enemy morale. Further, while I'm glad to have the comms channels free of such bombast…"


A hint of a smile flashes across his face.


"…even I'll admit the experience is satisfying. Take this, Guardian, and make sure they get your message."

entries.title: At Your Fingertips
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Upon Osiris's request, I've cleared you for more outings. He seems to think there are additional Foundry relics aboard that derelict that could enhance your rifle."


Zavala rests his chin on his knuckles. "I'm more concerned with these experiments Calus was conducting. If they were able to coax a response from the Darkness… Gather all the intel you can, and if you recover something useful, all the better."

entries.title: At Your Fingertips
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Caiatl assisted your investigation? It seems our enemies can be reasonable when they choose… or when it benefits them."


"If she wants to divulge intelligence let her, but keep your knowledge close to your chest."


"That piece you brought back. It… looks like an oddity."

entries.title: Balistraria Wrap
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Well done," Zavala says. "I wish all our Guardians could be as accurate as you."


With measured, ceremonial movements, he wraps a Vanguard banner around your rifle.


"Display this with pride," he says.

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Well done, Guardian." Zavala nods appreciatively. "Now that you're up to speed, challenge yourself with some more dangerous foes."


"Practice all week," he advises, "because during the weekends, you'll be able to earn high scores that will grant you rewards and buffs for the following week."


"We'll use a different operation to test you each week, so you'll have time to prepare your tactics. Keep track of your scores as you go," he concludes, "and show the whole Tower what you're made of."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"I'm glad you're joining the Guardian Games this year," Zavala greets you. "It's important to stay sharp, even when we're enjoying ourselves."


"To that end," he continues, "we've instituted a new way to track your accomplishments. You can now earn Vanguard Medals, which specifically track your achievements during those missions." 


"Remember: Guardian Games is not just about representing yourself or your class." The commander crosses his arms across his broad chest. "It's about honing our skills to become the best Guardians we can be."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Guardian. Good to see you participating in the Guardian Games." Zavala nods approvingly. "At times like these, we could all use a reprieve." 


"We'll be arranging different missions for you each week. This year, I leave it to you to decide how much of a challenge you're up for." He smiles knowingly. "Perform well and you'll win the right to light the ceremonial torches in the tower. Eva's set aside some interesting prizes."


Zavala's expression grows serious. "These Games have always been a means for Guardians to demonstrate their discipline. Their mastery of Light… and Dark." 


"But they also serve to remind the people of the City that we're here for them. That they can believe in us. Do them proud, Guardian."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Guardian. I'm glad to see you joining your fellow Lightbearers in this year's Games." Zavala is solemn despite the cheerful decorations surrounding him.


"Eva has outdone herself this year to make sure the Games are an event to remember.  Perform well and you'll win the right to light the ceremonial torches in the Tower. Along with a year's worth of bragging rights, as Eva would like me to remind you."


Zavala looks to the empty skyline. "The Witness is coming. We cannot forget the threat hanging over us. But the Guardian Games are just what we need: a test of discipline, a reminder of our strength, a celebration of who we are."


"We have faced the worst. We have not faltered yet." He nods to you. "And we won't. Get out there, Guardian. Show us your mettle… and have some fun."

entries.title: Best in Class
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Eva has outdone herself this year to make sure the Games are an event to remember. Perform well, and you'll win the right to light the ceremonial torches in the Tower. Along with a year's worth of bragging rights, as Eva would like me to remind you."


"There is a new challenge for you to overcome: Rushdown. Here's what you need to know." Zavala hands you a missive that reads:


RUSHDOWN
• Guardians are tasked with defeating 5 powerful combatants before the timer runs out.
• Each combatant defeated will increase the difficulty of combat.
• Guardians earn points by progressing quickly to reach higher score thresholds.
• Each day, there is a new combination of 5 powerful combatants to overcome.

entries.title: Beyond Light
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Now that Eramis is defeated, the Vanguard hopes to reclaim Europa for humanity. Zavala asks your help in destabilizing what remains of House Salvation. He informs you that Variks will help guide you through your first mission: sabotaging a Fallen weapons factory on Europa.


Return to Variks on Europa for more details.

entries.title: Beyond Light
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"These are unprecedented times. The arrival of these… Pyramids could change everything," Zavala says, gazing at the Traveler. He turns to face you.


"And yet, it changes nothing about our responsibility as Guardians. Now more than ever, with the Darkness at our door, it's important to remember who we are. Protectors. Warriors. Symbols of hope for all humanity."


"I don't know what you'll find if you journey out into the unknown, and I can't stop you from going. But I implore you…"


He looks back towards the Traveler, his brow tensed.


"Hold fast to your Light, Guardian. It could be the only thing between us and destruction."

entries.title: Challenger's Proving VII
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Commander Zavala has informed you that you have been chosen to fight for the City aboard the Imperial Land Tank, the Halphas Electus, on Nessus. Caiatl has accepted the challenge. Zavala tells you to assemble your fireteam and bring Caiatl's champion to their knees. He reminds you that if Caiatl suffers defeat here, she will have no choice but to concede or risk humiliation.

entries.title: Challenger's Proving VII
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Commander Zavala looks you over and considers how much you've kept from him. He congratulates you, and celebrates a victorious City, but expresses a need for trust, for unity. He says that without those things the City could be destroyed from the inside like the Cabal were.

entries.title: Clarion Call: Titans
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Hey Guardian,



        Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Clarion Call: Titans
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Now I know why they call it the European Dead Zone. You killed everything!

entries.title: Closing Ceremony
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: "Wear your medals proudly. They've been earned against the best." -Eva Levante

entries.title: Commander Zaval-AAH!
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"The Festival of the Lost is a City-wide tradition," Zavala says. "Guardians see death differently than others do, but we all know loss. And that brings us together."


He smiles. "As does celebration. We remember the dead and celebrate the living, so enjoy yourself, Guardian."

entries.title: Commander Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala carries upon his shoulders the burden of guilt for the loss of the City. The truth is this was a wake-up call for all of humanity. It's time to shore up our defenses and take the fight to our enemies. 


Report back to Zavala for Nightfall and strike activities.

entries.title: Dawning Delivery
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala's expression is unreadable as he accepts the cookies, but he nods in recognition of the thoughtful gift.

entries.title: Dawning's Gift: Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala thanks you for the thoughtful gift, and begins squeezing it immediately. Forcefully.

entries.title: Defender of Light
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala is grateful that you defeated Kridis, but he now has other concerns. He believes that any compromise regarding the Darkness will only lead to disaster. Now that Eramis and her council are defeated, Guardians must no longer wield the Darkness. He hopes you'll respect this decision and help defend it. The people of the Last City need you now more than ever.

entries.title: Done and Done
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"When you achieve the success seen here today, it's not just a personal victory. It's a victory for us all. You ensure that the enemy knows we give no quarter."


Zavala offers a small nod of approval. "Take this and keep reminding them."

entries.title: Engram Tracker
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
A recorded message from Master Rahool plays when you pick up the engram tracker: 


"Guardian! This is a new device of my own manufacture. It will allow you to monitor the number of engrams available at each of the vendors in the Tower."


"If you ever lose it, you can pick up a new one from any of those vendors. I look forward to seeing you deploy this device."

entries.title: Exodus: Evacuation
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala looks over the City. "Preparing for battle across four fronts… we're spread too thin," he says quietly.


"As of now, our plan changes from preparation to evacuation."


He takes a measured breath. For a moment, he looks old.


"Sloane asked whether we could spare a Vanguard ship to relocate important cargo. Coming from her, that's a full-on distress call. Head to Titan, help her tie up loose ends, and bring her home."


"I have also been in contact with Asher Mir on Io. He insists the data he's gathering is too important to abandon. Of course, his phrasing was a bit more colorful."


You nod.


"Thank you, Guardian," he says reflexively. It's clear his mind is far away.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Complete strikes and challenges to get Vanguard Tactician tokens and earn Level 20 rewards from Commander Zavala.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Your reputation in the Vanguard war effort precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Your reputation in the Crucible precedes you. Take this reward in recognition of your deeds.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Complete bounties for XP and undertake quests for valuable gear. Completing strikes grants you tokens, which can be turned in here for packages.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Complete strikes and Battlegrounds. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.

entries.title: Faction Reward
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Complete Vanguard Ops. Earn armor and weapons at each rank, and powerful upgrades at major ranks.

entries.title: Final Dawn
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala's gaze is transfixed on the empty space where the Traveler once hung in the sky.


"For a moment," he says quietly, "I thought my greatest fear had become reality. That the Traveler had decided to leave us to fend for ourselves."


He turns to face you, a look of tired relief in his eyes. "But in that moment, I also had another thought."


Gesturing broadly to the City, Zavala casts his eyes upward once more. "The last time I saw Cabal ships in the sky over the City, I looked to the Traveler to save us. But now? Cabal, Eliksni, Awoken… our allies have rallied to us. We look to each other, instead."


Zavala rolls his shoulders, then squares them to the challenge ahead. "In the wake of Rasputin's sacrifice, the Wrathborn have begun pulling back their forces. But I can't shake the feeling that they're just making way for an even greater threat."


When he looks at you again, it is with steel in his eyes. "Whatever the Traveler's intentions, it chose to stay with us. Just as we have chosen to stand together."

entries.title: Forsaken
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala doesn't have the luxury of revenge. He has the City to think of. He won't give you his blessing as you head to the Tangled Shore in mission "High Plains Blues."

entries.title: Forsaken
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: You got the revenge you wanted, but Commander Zavala reminds you of what you risked to do so. Uldren's death will have consequences. Of that Zavala is sure.

entries.title: Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: "It's all fun and games until somebody loses a bet." -Prak'kesh

entries.title: Guardian Games
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: "Congratulations on your performance in this year's Guardian Games. You should be proud of your accomplishments, regardless of the outcome. It's time to honor all of our classes and celebrate their achievements. Visit the podium to see the results of this year's competition." -Commander Zavala

entries.title: Heroic Strikes
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Commander Zavala has prepared a list of priority targets for strike operations. 


Join other Guardians and complete strikes to take down powerful foes and earn rewards.

entries.title: Heroic Strikes
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala congratulates you on your performance in strikes-and offers a reward fit for such a heroic effort.

entries.title: Holding Patterns
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Commander Zavala gives you a weary wave as you approach. 


"Guardian, I'm glad to hear that your siege-breaking operation is a success. Every member of the Witness's forces you defeat on Earth may well be one less we'll face on the other side of that portal." He gestures broadly toward the sky. 


"That's especially important because we won't be able to bring all our forces through at once. It will be all we can to just to keep the portal stabilized. We'll need to begin the assault with a small advance team-and you'll be the tip of the spear."


He lets out a frustrated sigh. "Unfortunately, until then there's little left to do but wait."


"I've never had Saladin's patience. Or Shaxx's… raw instinct."


"For a Titan like me, the calm before the storm is anything but." His attention is caught by a strident signal on his datapad. Another high-priority report, no doubt.


He gives you a brief nod. "Go get some rest, Guardian. You'll need it."

entries.title: In Rides a Pale Horse
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Guardian, there's something I'd like you to retrieve from the Vanguard vault. We've been storing certain high-value weapons here since losing our vaults during the Red War. The Cabal seek to destroy us with the Almighty. I want to send them a message, and I have the perfect delivery method. Take this keycard to the vault."


Before you can take the keycard, Zavala pulls it back.


"You'll have to go through my office to access it. I normally do not allow Guardians in there, so I'm trusting you not to disrupt any of my… personal effects. Grab the weapon and come back to me."

entries.title: Increase Reputation
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Show Zavala proof of your deeds in the Vanguard war effort.

entries.title: Legacy: Beyond Light
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Now that Eramis is defeated, the Vanguard hopes to reclaim Europa for humanity. Zavala asks your help in destabilizing what remains of House Salvation. He informs you that Variks will help guide you through your first mission: sabotaging a Fallen weapons factory on Europa.


Return to Variks on Europa for more details.

entries.title: Legacy: Bound in Sorrow
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"A hollow man… leading others to die… for a silent god."


Zavala's failure to complete the ritual of severance has shaken him to the core of his faith. The Nightmare that haunts him-Safiyah-is unknown to the Vanguard, yet has great power over his heart.


"She wants me to speak her name… To confide my feelings in you. What good does it do?"


"Go and see Eris. I'll tell her you're coming. She'll know what to say."


Travel to the H.E.L.M. and see what Eris knows.

entries.title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving VII
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Commander Zavala looks you over and considers how much you've kept from him. He congratulates you, and celebrates a victorious City, but expresses a need for trust, for unity. He says that without those things the City could be destroyed from the inside like the Cabal were.

entries.title: Legacy: Challenger's Proving VII
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Commander Zavala has informed you that you have been chosen to fight for the City aboard the Imperial Land Tank, the Halphas Electus, on Nessus. Caiatl has accepted the challenge. Zavala tells you to assemble your fireteam and bring Caiatl's champion to their knees. He reminds you that if Caiatl suffers defeat here, she will have no choice but to concede or risk humiliation.

entries.title: Legacy: Forsaken
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala doesn't have the luxury of revenge. He has the City to think of. He won't give you his blessing as you head to the Tangled Shore in mission "High Plains Blues."

entries.title: Legacy: Forsaken
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: You got the revenge you wanted, but Commander Zavala reminds you of what you risked to do so. Uldren's death will have consequences. Of that Zavala is sure.

entries.title: Legacy: HIGH ALERT: ANOMALY DETECTED - H.E.L.M.
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala sees you coming and steps forward to meet you.  "I heard."


He exhales slowly. "Calus's plans are foiled-his vessel stranded without a heartbeat above the Moon." He shakes his head. "I'm not sure how he projected himself into the H.E.L.M., but it was the same here, over the homes of the people we protect."


His brow furrows with focus. "Only a coward terrorizes innocents."


Zavala looks you dead in the eyes. "Calus, and this… Witness think they can intimidate us. It's always the ones who claim to be invincible that crack first, and they've just challenged every Guardian in the system."


"Another conflict on the horizon. I can't say I'm eager to meet it, but if it's in defense of our citizens… not the Traveler, not the Light, but for the people behind our walls… we'll be ready."

entries.title: Legacy: Last Will and Testament
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Commander Zavala hands you a handwritten note from Amanda Holliday:


"Guardian-


If you're reading this, then I guess I'm not 'round the Hangar anymore. 


"I hope I went out on a mission, not by getting run over by some New Light figuring out how their landing gear works.


"Either way, I'm leaving you my personal ship. She's seen me through a lot of scrapes, and I know you'll take good care of each other. 


"I've always been bad at goodbyes, so instead, I'll just say… give 'em hell, Guardian. 


-Amanda"

entries.title: Legacy: Lightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"We stand alongside more friends than ever before." The Humans of Neomuna are just as much included in that as those of the Last City. They have stood fast on the front lines of this conflict, and because of them, the Last City has been saved from more violence at its doorstep.


It isn't everything, but that thin line has made a huge difference.


"Now, I look up and see the hope we've built for ourselves." There is a gentle awe in the way Zavala regards the sky: the fleets of ships, the symbols of allies of the Last City. The Vanguard is no longer one last bastion against the Witness, but one of many.


Even without the Traveler, we are not alone.


And we'll need all the allies we can get. This war is far from over. Ikora has been in contact with Osiris regarding the mysteries yet unsolved. Visit her to learn more.

entries.title: Legacy: Shadowkeep
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
No need to waver, Guardian. The Vanguard stands behind you every step of the way.


The Light is our strength. The Darkness will never take that from us. 


Fight on.

entries.title: Lightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"So much has changed." Zavala stares into the space where the Traveler once hung.


"I once stood here to gaze at the savior of humanity, our only hope. Now that hope is gone from my sight.


"But I see something in its place. I see the fruits of alliance, I see the tenacity of our people, I see a fighting chance.


"So as the Witness plagues our skies…


"Fight, Guardian. Fight."

entries.title: Loaded Question
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote: Zavala congratulates you on your dedication to fighting the biggest threats to humanity, and he gives you a reward worthy of your heroism.

entries.title: Making an Impact
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Making an Impact



        For Zavala, trust once broken is not easily mended. But if you continue to put the effort into repairing this relationship, so will he.

entries.title: Making an Impact
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Making an Impact



        The City's defense falls on Zavala's shoulders, and Zavala needs proof that he can count on you to fight with the Vanguard.


Prove your dedication to the Vanguard by completing a strike wearing a full set of Vanguard armor.

entries.title: Meet with Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
The perpetually concerned look on Zavala's face lifts briefly as you approach.


"I see that your recent victories haven't dulled your edge. You're still pushing yourself to get better every day-an example I hope our New Lights follow."


"It's easy lose ourselves in the heady cosmic concerns that threaten the City, but in the heat of battle, a Guardian is only as good as their training."


He nods appreciatively at your battle-worn armor. "And I rest easy knowing that nobody trains harder than you."

entries.title: Meet with Zavala
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Zavala looks exhausted, but alert. He hails you warmly as you approach.


"It's important that everyone in the Tower sees you training so fiercely. Your legend now exceeds even my own. Everyone looks up to you - both civilians and Lightbearers alike."


"You may not be a member of the Vanguard, but you set the tone for the Tower. Your work in the field is the realization of all of our efforts, right down to the sweeper bots."


"Thank you for taking your role, and our safety, as seriously as you do."

entries.title: Missing in Action
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"Stolen? No one outside of the Vanguard should have access to the vault, let alone revoke our access. If this is a breach, we will need to boost security measures considerably. While we were looking up to the sky, someone snuck in right under our noses."


Zavala rubs his chin, pensively.


"I want answers and I want that weapon recovered. I know of some BrayTech equipment that can help us track it down. Go see Ana on Mars."

entries.title: Nightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Hi Guardian.



        The City has been liberated, but threats to our survival remain. Zavala has authorized the Nightfall protocol to dispatch elite Guardian fireteams for surgical strikes against the greatest of these threats. 


Each week, assemble your fireteam and complete the Nightfall strike to earn valuable rewards.

entries.title: Nightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Hey there Guardian.



        The Nightfall protocol is authorized only in the event of an imminent threat to the City. Thanks to you, that threat is ended.

entries.title: Nightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
"You have stood against every foe and driven them to break. A commendable effort, Guardian. One that does not go unnoticed.


"I assume you've heard the people recounting your deeds throughout the City? You command their respect, and hold their hope. They look to you as the first who will stand against the coming tide. I know you will not fail them. Carry on." -Commander Zavala

entries.title: Nightfall
entries.speaker: Commander Zavala
entries.quote:
Commander Zavala straightens his stance and meets your eyes directly. "I've heard of your… adventures." His shoulders relax. "Impeccable work, Guardian. You've transcended our expectations yet again."


Zavala buries a prideful smile. "However, there is always more work to be done. Remain on the fireteam, and remain vigilant. Carry on."
